    new_MATLAB_instance_created=False,quit_called=False,workspace_cleared=False)

"""Execute one source-pinned purpose in the user-authorized existing MATLAB."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,time,traceback

B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;T=B.parent;R=B/'reports'
def put(path,value):
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
def main():
    a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('--purpose-json',required=True,type=Path);args=a.parse_args()
    request_bytes=args.purpose_json.read_bytes();p=json.loads(request_bytes)
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z0-9_]+',p['id']) and p['expected_PID']==71796
    assert p['no_model_raw_GPU_or_training'] and p['existing_session_only']
    for row in p['source_pins']:
        path=Path(row['path']);assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(T.resolve())
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['SHA'],str(path)
    for path in p['new_output_paths']:assert not Path(path).exists(),path
    import win32com.client
    matlab=win32com.client.GetActiveObject('Matlab.Application')
    output=matlab.Execute("disp(jsonencode(struct('pid',feature('getpid'),'version',version)));")
    m=re.search(r'\{[^\r\n]*"pid"[^\r\n]*\}',str(output));assert m,str(output)
    identity=json.loads(m.group(0));assert identity['pid']==p['expected_PID'],identity
    marker=R/(p['id']+'_PURPOSE_CONSUMED_BEFORE_COM_EXECUTION.json')
    put(marker,dict(epoch=time.time(),request=p,request_SHA=hashlib.sha256(request_bytes).hexdigest(),actual_session=identity))
    r=dict(id=p['id'],epoch_started=time.time(),actual_session=identity,physical_teacher_valid=False)
    try:r.update(COM_call_returned=True,original_MATLAB_output=str(matlab.Execute(p['expression'])))
    except BaseException:r.update(COM_call_returned=False,original_error=traceback.format_exc())
    r['epoch_returned']=time.time()
    r['outputs']=[dict(path=path,exists=Path(path).exists(),bytes=Path(path).stat().st_size if Path(path).is_file() else None) for path in p['new_output_paths']]
    r['all_expected_outputs_present']=all(x['exists'] for x in r['outputs'])
    put(R/(p['id']+'_ORIGINAL_RETURNED_ACTUAL.json'),r)
    print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['COM_call_returned'] and r['all_expected_outputs_present'] else 1)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

function matlab_session_bootstrap139()

s = struct();

s.pid = feature('getpid');
s.version = version;
s.release = version('-release');
s.matlab_root = matlabroot;

function report=probe139_bounded_ground_launch_authority_v2_once()
% Instantaneous nominal contact/effort LP, not a trajectory or physical jump.
% The six motor torques act through the original joints. No external push.
base=fileparts(mfilename('fullpath'));T=fileparts(base);out=fullfile(base,'reports','ROOT139_V2_BOUNDED_GROUND_LAUNCH_AUTHORITY_LP_ACTUAL.json');
assert(~isfile(out),'Preserve first launch-authority LP');assert(feature('getpid')==71796);
p=fullfile(T,'MOD4_H1_FUDAN133_LINE_Z_RESOURCE_V134_20261030','payloads_v2','seed27');
C=jsondecode(fileread(fullfile(p,'job0','assets','import_contract.json')));
G=jsondecode(fileread(fullfile(p,'source','OWN_STEP_WHEEL_GEOMETRY_FROM_R2_SOURCE.json')));
seed=jsondecode(fileread(fullfile(base,'reports','ROOT139_V2_MATLAB_CONSTRAINED_TEACHER_SEED_FIRST_ACTUAL','SEED_RESULT_ACTUAL.json')));
names=cellstr(string(seed.joint_names));labels={'extension','tuck'};indices=[1,5];rows=cell(2,1);
try
for k=1:2
    q=seed.q30_reference_only(indices(k),:)';
    f=@(roll)wheelDifference(C,G,names,q,roll);
    assert(f(-.25)*f(.25)<=0,'Two-wheel floor orientation is not bracketed');
    roll=fzero(f,[-.25,.25]);R=rx(roll);g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q,zeros(3,1),R);
    s=struct('p',[0;0;-min(g.wheel_low(3,:))],'R',R,'v',zeros(3,1),'w',zeros(3,1),'q',q,'dq',zeros(30,1));
    d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q,s.p,R);
    [~,rr,piv]=qr(d.loop_J(:,7:36)','vector');dg=abs(diag(rr));tol=1e-9*max([dg;1]);r=sum(dg>tol);sel=piv(1:r);J=d.loop_J(sel,:);
    bodyNames=cellstr(string(G.body_names));JC=zeros(6,36);points=zeros(3,2);
    wheels={'left_wheel','right_wheel'};
    for j=1:2
        b=find(strcmp(bodyNames,wheels{j}),1);points(:,j)=wheelSupport(C,G,d,b,wheels{j});
        offset=points(:,j)-d.body_position(:,b);
        JC((j-1)*3+(1:3),:)=d.body_origin_Jv(:,:,b)-skew(offset)*d.body_Jw(:,:,b);
    end
    K=[d.M,-J',-JC';J,zeros(r,r+6);JC,zeros(6,r+6)];
    z0=K\[d.gas_generalized_force-d.h;-d.loop_Jdot_velocity(sel);zeros(6,1)];
    Z=K\[d.B_action_torque_order6;zeros(r+6,6)];
    a0=z0(1:36);At=Z(1:36,:);F0=z0(36+r+(1:6));Ft=Z(36+r+(1:6),:);
    % Conservative four-facet L1 friction cone, nominal mu=.7, not measured.
    mu=.7;A=[];bvec=[];
    for j=1:2
        ids=(j-1)*3+(1:3);v=F0(ids);V=Ft(ids,:);
        A=[A;-V(3,:)];bvec=[bvec;v(3)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        for sx=[-1,1]
            for sy=[-1,1]
                A=[A;sx*V(1,:)+sy*V(2,:)-mu*V(3,:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
                bvec=[bvec;-sx*v(1)-sy*v(2)+mu*v(3)]; %#ok<AGROW>
            end
        end
    end
    actNames={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'};
    [ok,act]=ismember(actNames,names);assert(all(ok));
    cap=[repmat(C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm,4,1);repmat(C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm,2,1)];
    lower=-cap;upper=cap;lower(1:4)=max(lower(1:4),60*(-3-q(act(1:4))));upper(1:4)=min(upper(1:4),60*(3-q(act(1:4))));
    for pair=[1,3]
        row=zeros(1,6);row(pair)=1;row(pair+1)=-1;delta=q(act(pair))-q(act(pair+1));
        A=[A;row;-row];bvec=[bvec;60*(.85-delta);60*(delta+1.0843)]; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
    % A distinct teacher-reference comparison; these are not new task guards.
    com0=d.COM_Jv*a0+d.COM_acceleration_bias;comT=d.COM_Jv*At;
    angularT=At(4:6,:);angular0=a0(4:6);
    A=[A;angularT;-angularT;comT(2,:);-comT(2,:);comT(1,:);-comT(1,:)];
    bvec=[bvec;20-angular0;20+angular0;1-com0(2);1+com0(2);4-com0(1);com0(1)];
    objective=-(d.COM_Jv(3,:)*At)';
    [tau,~,flag,solver]=linprog(objective,A,bvec,[],[],lower,upper,optimoptions('linprog','Display','none'));
    assert(flag>0 && numel(tau)==6,'No feasible instantaneous nominal motor/contact LP');
    acc=a0+At*tau;forces=reshape(F0+Ft*tau,3,2);
    processed=[q(act(1:4))+tau(1:4)/60;tau(5:6)/.6];raw=[processed(1:4)/.5;processed(5:6)/10];
    generalizedForce=d.B_action_torque_order6*tau+d.gas_generalized_force-d.h;
    lambda=z0(37:36+r)+Z(37:36+r,:)*tau;
    rows{k}=struct('pose',labels{k},'source_mass_kg',d.total_mass_kg,'base_roll_for_floor_rad',roll, ...
        'wheel_support_point_world_m',points,'floor_wheel_bottom_m',g.wheel_low(3,:), ...
        'initial_all_loop_residual_max',max(abs(d.loop_phi)),'selected_joint_only_loop_rank',r, ...
        'KKT_rcond',rcond(K),'LP_exitflag',flag,'solver',solver,'tau6_Nm',tau, ...
        'processed6_at_zero_joint_speed',processed,'raw6_at_zero_joint_speed',raw, ...
        'ground_reaction_world_N',forces,'mu_assumed_not_measured',mu, ...
        'COM_acceleration_m_s2',d.COM_Jv*acc+d.COM_acceleration_bias, ...
        'root_acceleration_m_s2',acc(1:3),'body_angular_acceleration_rad_s2',acc(4:6), ...
        'max_LP_violation',max([0;A*tau-bvec]),'all_loop_acceleration_defect',max(abs(d.loop_J*acc+d.loop_Jdot_velocity)), ...
        'ground_contact_acceleration_defect',max(abs(JC*acc)), ...
        'dynamics_defect',max(abs(d.M*acc-generalizedForce-J'*lambda-JC'*forces(:))), ...
        'free_base_motion_not_prescribed',true,'physical_teacher_valid',false);
end
report=struct('schema','mod4.teacher139.nominal_instantaneous_ground_launch_authority.v1', ...
    'status','RETURNED_BOUNDED_INSTANTANEOUS_CONTACT_EFFORT_COMPARISON', ...
    'rows',{rows},'dt_or_duration_not_assumed',true,'no_takeoff_velocity_injection',true, ...
    'not_integrated_impulse_or_jump_height',true,'contact_model','Two authored-shape support points, sticking, conservative L1 friction; not cooked PhysX contacts', ...
    'teacher_reference_bounds',struct('angular_acceleration_abs_rad_s2',20,'lateral_COM_acceleration_abs_m_s2',1,'forward_COM_acceleration_m_s2',[0,4]), ...
    'no_nonwheel_or_self_collision_proof',true,'no_policy_model_or_GPU',true,'physical_teacher_valid',false);
catch ME
report=struct('status','ORIGINAL_GROUND_LP_ERROR_NOT_RETRIED','message',ME.message,'identifier',ME.identifier, ...
    'stack',ME.stack,'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'),'completed_rows',{rows},'physical_teacher_valid',false);
end
fout=fopen(out,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(fout>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(fout));fprintf(fout,'%s\n',jsonencode(report,PrettyPrint=true));
end
function d=wheelDifference(C,G,names,q,roll)
g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q,zeros(3,1),rx(roll));d=g.wheel_low(3,1)-g.wheel_low(3,2);
end
function point=wheelSupport(~,G,d,b,name)
shapes=G.shapes;if isstruct(shapes),shapes=num2cell(shapes);end
point=[0;0;inf];n=[0;0;-1];
for i=1:numel(shapes)
    h=shapes{i};if ~strcmp(h.body,name),continue;end
    A=d.body_rotation(:,:,b)*h.linear_body_from_shape;centre=d.body_position(:,b)+d.body_rotation(:,:,b)*h.origin_body_m(:);
    switch h.type
        case 'Mesh'
            vertices=A*h.points'+centre;z=min(vertices(3,:));v=mean(vertices(:,abs(vertices(3,:)-z)<1e-12),2);
        case 'Cube'
            v=centre+A*(h.size/2*sign(A'*n));
        case {'Cylinder','Capsule'}
            ax=double(h.axis)+1;rad=setdiff(1:3,ax);v=centre+A(:,ax)*(h.height/2*sign(A(:,ax)'*n));
            if strcmp(h.type,'Cylinder'),Ar=A(:,rad);else,Ar=A;end
            denom=norm(Ar'*n);if denom>0,v=v+h.radius*(Ar*(Ar'*n))/denom;end
        otherwise,error('Unqualified authored support shape');
    end
    if v(3)<point(3),point=v;end
end
assert(all(isfinite(point)));
end
function R=rx(a),R=[1 0 0;0 cos(a) -sin(a);0 sin(a) cos(a)];end
function S=skew(v),S=[0 -v(3) v(2);v(3) 0 -v(1);-v(2) v(1) 0];end

    'status','RETURNED_INSTANTANEOUS_NOMINAL_CONTACT_EFFORT_DIAGNOSTIC', ...

    'no_nonwheel_or_self_collision_proof',true,'no_policy_model_or_GPU',true,'physical_teacher_valid',false);
catch ME
report=struct('status','ORIGINAL_GROUND_LP_ERROR_NOT_RETRIED','message',ME.message,'identifier',ME.identifier, ...
    'stack',ME.stack,'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'),'completed_rows',{rows},'physical_teacher_valid',false);

function d=wheelDifference(C,G,names,q,roll)
g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q,zeros(3,1),rx(roll));d=g.wheel_low(3,1)-g.wheel_low(3,2);
end
function point=wheelSupport(~,G,d,b,name)
shapes=G.shapes;if isstruct(shapes),shapes=num2cell(shapes);end
point=[0;0;inf];n=[0;0;-1];
for i=1:numel(shapes)
    h=shapes{i};if ~strcmp(h.body,name),continue;end
    A=d.body_rotation(:,:,b)*h.linear_body_from_shape;centre=d.body_position(:,b)+d.body_rotation(:,:,b)*h.origin_body_m(:);
    switch h.type
        case 'Mesh'
            vertices=A*h.points'+centre;z=min(vertices(3,:));v=mean(vertices(:,abs(vertices(3,:)-z)<1e-12),2);
        case 'Cube'
            v=centre+A*(h.size/2*sign(A'*n));
        case {'Cylinder','Capsule'}
            ax=double(h.axis)+1;rad=setdiff(1:3,ax);v=centre+A(:,ax)*(h.height/2*sign(A(:,ax)'*n));
            if strcmp(h.type,'Cylinder'),Ar=A(:,rad);else,Ar=A;end
            denom=norm(Ar'*n);if denom>0,v=v+h.radius*(Ar*(Ar'*n))/denom;end
        otherwise,error('Unqualified authored support shape');
    end
    if v(3)<point(3),point=v;end
end
assert(all(isfinite(point)));
end
function R=rx(a),R=[1 0 0;0 cos(a) -sin(a);0 sin(a) cos(a)];end
function S=skew(v),S=[0 -v(3) v(2);v(3) 0 -v(1);-v(2) v(1) 0];end

function root_run139_fk_then_seed_once()
% ROOT authorized two new purposes: FK port check then constrained seed solve.
% Neither is a physical teacher qualification or a state-playback controller.
base=fileparts(mfilename('fullpath'));
T=fileparts(base);
source=fullfile(T,'H1_OWN_MOD4_TEACHER_TRAJECTORY_MATLAB_SOURCE_V1_20261030','source');
addpath(source);
payload=fullfile(T,'MOD4_H1_FUDAN133_LINE_Z_RESOURCE_V134_20261030','payloads_v2','seed27');
contract=fullfile(payload,'job0','assets','import_contract.json');
geometry=fullfile(payload,'source','OWN_STEP_WHEEL_GEOMETRY_FROM_R2_SOURCE.json');
witness=fullfile(payload,'source','OWN_JUMP130_LEG_GEOMETRY_WITNESSES.json');
failure=fullfile(base,'reports','ROOT139_ORIGINAL_MATLAB_PIPELINE_ERROR_ACTUAL.json');
assert(~isfile(failure),'Preserve original pipeline error.');
try
    assert(feature('getpid')==71796,'Unexpected MATLAB session identity');
    fkDir=fullfile(base,'reports','ROOT139_OWN_FK_PORT_QUALIFICATION_ACTUAL');
    fk=solve_mod4_teacher_seed_v1(contract,geometry,witness,fkDir,struct('runOptimization',false));
    assert(fk.seed_pose_diagnostics.extension.closure_all_anchor_max_m<.002);
    assert(fk.seed_pose_diagnostics.tuck.closure_all_anchor_max_m<.002);
    assert(abs(fk.mass_kg-14.220140287652612)<1e-8,'Source-mass transfer differs');
    fprintf('ROOT139 own-model FK port check completed; not a dynamics proof.\n');
    outDir=fullfile(base,'reports','ROOT139_MATLAB_CONSTRAINED_TEACHER_SEED_FIRST_ACTUAL');
    result=run_mod4_teacher_seed_entry_v1(outDir); %#ok<NASGU>
    fprintf('ROOT139 constrained seed attempt returned; physical teacher still unqualified.\n');
catch ME
    assert(~isfile(failure),'Preserve original pipeline error.');
    fid=fopen(failure,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(fid>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(fid));
    fprintf(fid,'%s\n',jsonencode(struct('status','ORIGINAL_ERROR_NOT_RETRIED', ...
        'identifier',ME.identifier,'message',ME.message,'stack',ME.stack, ...
        'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'),'physical_teacher_valid',false),PrettyPrint=true));
    rethrow(ME);
end
end

function writeNew(path,value)

end

function [s,tau6,receipt]=action6_pd_queue_source_v1(raw6,q,dq,names,s,p,tick)
% Source translation of original6 target mapping/PD/physical-delay queue.
% ROOT must bind/readback coefficients and EXACT original motor clip function.
% No SDK access, sampling, force-cap changes or external body forces here.
% This source component is not admitted as an original-runtime replacement.
order={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'};
[ok,ids]=ismember(order,cellstr(string(names)));assert(all(ok));
q=q(:);dq=dq(:);raw6=raw6(:);assert(numel(raw6)==6 && all(isfinite(raw6)));
assert(isa(p.original_motor_clip6,'function_handle'),'ROOT must supply exact source-pinned original clip, not guessed abs-speed envelope');
assert(all(ismember(p.lag_steps2,[0,1,2])) && numel(p.lag_steps2)==2);
assert(numel(p.leg_default_q4)==4 && numel(p.leg_kp4)==4 && numel(p.leg_kd4)==4 && numel(p.wheel_kd2)==2);
assert(numel(p.episode_gain6)==6 && numel(p.step_gain6)==6);
if isempty(s)
    assert(tick==0,'Initialize once at a new scene; native reset semantics need a separate ROOT binding');
    neutral=[p.leg_default_q4(:);zeros(2,1)];
    s=struct('pending',neutral,'applied',neutral,'pending_valid',false(2,1), ...
        'due_tick',[-1;-1],'issue_tick',[-1;-1],'applied_issue_tick',[-1;-1], ...
        'first_apply_tick',[-1;-1],'last_tick',-1,'last_submit_tick',-1);
end
assert(tick==s.last_tick+1,'Exactly one apply per original2.5ms callback');
if mod(tick,4)==0
    assert(tick==0 || tick-s.last_submit_tick==4);
    a=max(-6,min(6,raw6));legs=.5*a(1:4)+p.leg_default_q4(:);wheels=10*a(5:6);
    legs(1)=max(legs(1),legs(2)+p.diff_min);legs(3)=max(legs(3),legs(4)+p.diff_min);
    legs(1)=min(legs(1),legs(2)+p.diff_max);legs(3)=min(legs(3),legs(4)+p.diff_max);
    assert(~any(s.pending_valid),'Old command must have reached actuator before next100Hz decision');
    s.pending=[legs;wheels];s.pending_valid(:)=true;s.issue_tick(:)=tick;
    s.due_tick=tick+p.lag_steps2(:);s.last_submit_tick=tick;
end
groups={1:4,5:6};
for k=1:2
    if s.pending_valid(k) && tick>=s.due_tick(k)
        assert(tick==s.due_tick(k));s.applied(groups{k})=s.pending(groups{k});s.pending_valid(k)=false;
        s.applied_issue_tick(k)=s.issue_tick(k);s.first_apply_tick(k)=tick;
    end
end
requested=[p.leg_kp4(:).*(s.applied(1:4)-q(ids(1:4)))-p.leg_kd4(:).*dq(ids(1:4)); ...
    p.wheel_kd2(:).*(s.applied(5:6)-dq(ids(5:6)))];
first=p.original_motor_clip6(requested,dq(ids));
scaled=first(:).*p.episode_gain6(:).*p.step_gain6(:);
if any(strcmp(p.mild_profile,{'white_v1','white_v2','white_v3'}))
    tau6=p.original_motor_clip6(scaled,dq(ids));
else
    tau6=scaled;
end
s.last_tick=tick;
receipt=struct('tick',tick,'processed_applied_target6',s.applied,'requested_PD_torque6',requested, ...
    'first_clip6',first,'episode_step_scaled6',scaled,'final_torque6',tau6, ...
    'physical_transition_delay_s',.0025*(s.first_apply_tick-s.applied_issue_tick), ...
    'applied_issue_tick',s.applied_issue_tick,'first_apply_tick',s.first_apply_tick, ...
    'no_random_sampling',true,'no_external_force',true, ...
    'scope','SOURCE_COMPONENT_REQUIRES_ROOT_EXACT_CLIP_GAIN_QUEUE_RESET_ADMISSION');
end

function [tau,r]=dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(effort,velocity,effortLimit,saturation,velocityLimit)
% Exact formula translation of captured210 DCMotor._clip_effort, NOT proof
% of72 installed SDK equivalence. ROOT must retain that source-origin label.
% Source SHA105f0341f972102f6bd5b0c544bc7c0510662241389a9decd24406bb2371d27e.
effort=effort(:);velocity=velocity(:);effortLimit=effortLimit(:);saturation=saturation(:);velocityLimit=velocityLimit(:);
assert(all(saturation>0) && all(velocityLimit>0) && all(effortLimit>0));
vAtLimit=velocityLimit.*(1+effortLimit./saturation);
clippedVelocity=max(-vAtLimit,min(vAtLimit,velocity));
top=saturation.*(1-clippedVelocity./velocityLimit);
bottom=saturation.*(-1-clippedVelocity./velocityLimit);
hi=min(top,effortLimit);lo=max(bottom,-effortLimit);
tau=max(lo,min(hi,effort));
r=struct('clipped_velocity',clippedVelocity,'lower',lo,'upper',hi,'v_at_effort_limit',vAtLimit, ...
    'origin','CAPTURED210_SOURCE_NOT_72_RUNTIME_EQUIVALENCE');
end

function report=run_nominal_action6_free_integrator_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,projectedSeedPath,outFile,options)
% ROOT-only two-control/eight-callback ACTION-DRIVEN no-contact source unit.
% It is NOT a grounded jump, H1 episode, airborne reset, teacher or PhysX pass.
% Base motion is integrated from M/h, gas and six motor actions. Never insert
% the seed vx/vz/root flight curve. Start all velocities at zero.
if nargin<5,options=struct;end
assert(~isfile(outFile),'Preserve consumed attempt output');
assert(isfield(options,'matrix_source_file'),'ROOT binds exact corrected gas2000 component');

function s=configurationCorrection(s,delta)
s.p=s.p+delta(1:3);s.R=expm(skew(delta(4:6)))*s.R;s.q=s.q+delta(7:36);
end
function A=skew(v),v=v(:);A=[0 -v(3) v(2);v(3) 0 -v(1);-v(2) v(1) 0];end

function [s,tau6,receipt]=action6_pd_queue_source_v1(raw6,q,dq,names,s,p,tick)
% Source translation of original6 target mapping/PD/physical-delay queue.
% ROOT must bind/readback coefficients and EXACT original motor clip function.
% No SDK access, sampling, force-cap changes or external body forces here.
% This source component is not admitted as an original-runtime replacement.
order={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'};
[ok,ids]=ismember(order,cellstr(string(names)));assert(all(ok));
q=q(:);dq=dq(:);raw6=raw6(:);assert(numel(raw6)==6 && all(isfinite(raw6)));
assert(isa(p.original_motor_clip6,'function_handle'),'ROOT must supply exact source-pinned original clip, not guessed abs-speed envelope');
assert(all(ismember(p.lag_steps2,[0,1,2])) && numel(p.lag_steps2)==2);
assert(numel(p.leg_default_q4)==4 && numel(p.leg_kp4)==4 && numel(p.leg_kd4)==4 && numel(p.wheel_kd2)==2);
assert(numel(p.episode_gain6)==6 && numel(p.step_gain6)==6);
if isempty(s)
    assert(tick==0,'Initialize once at a new scene; native reset semantics need a separate ROOT binding');
    neutral=[p.leg_default_q4(:);zeros(2,1)];
    s=struct('pending',neutral,'applied',neutral,'pending_valid',false(2,1), ...
        'due_tick',[-1;-1],'issue_tick',[-1;-1],'applied_issue_tick',[-1;-1], ...
        'first_apply_tick',[-1;-1],'last_tick',-1,'last_submit_tick',-1);
end
assert(tick==s.last_tick+1,'Exactly one apply per original2.5ms callback');
if mod(tick,4)==0
    assert(tick==0 || tick-s.last_submit_tick==4);
    a=max(-6,min(6,raw6));legs=.5*a(1:4)+p.leg_default_q4(:);wheels=10*a(5:6);
    legs(1)=max(legs(1),legs(2)+p.diff_min);legs(3)=max(legs(3),legs(4)+p.diff_min);
    legs(1)=min(legs(1),legs(2)+p.diff_max);legs(3)=min(legs(3),legs(4)+p.diff_max);
    assert(~any(s.pending_valid),'Old command must have reached actuator before next100Hz decision');
    s.pending=[legs;wheels];s.pending_valid(:)=true;s.issue_tick(:)=tick;
    s.due_tick=tick+p.lag_steps2(:);s.last_submit_tick=tick;
end
groups={1:4,5:6};
for k=1:2
    if s.pending_valid(k) && tick>=s.due_tick(k)
        assert(tick==s.due_tick(k));s.applied(groups{k})=s.pending(groups{k});s.pending_valid(k)=false;
        s.applied_issue_tick(k)=s.issue_tick(k);s.first_apply_tick(k)=tick;
    end
end
requested=[p.leg_kp4(:).*(s.applied(1:4)-q(ids(1:4)))-p.leg_kd4(:).*dq(ids(1:4)); ...
    p.wheel_kd2(:).*(s.applied(5:6)-dq(ids(5:6)))];
first=p.original_motor_clip6(requested,dq(ids));
scaled=first(:).*p.episode_gain6(:).*p.step_gain6(:);
if any(strcmp(p.mild_profile,{'white_v1','white_v2','white_v3'}))
    tau6=p.original_motor_clip6(scaled,dq(ids));
else
    tau6=scaled;
end
s.last_tick=tick;
receipt=struct('tick',tick,'processed_applied_target6',s.applied,'requested_PD_torque6',requested, ...
    'first_clip6',first,'episode_step_scaled6',scaled,'final_torque6',tau6, ...
    'physical_transition_delay_s',.0025*(s.first_apply_tick-s.applied_issue_tick), ...
    'applied_issue_tick',s.applied_issue_tick,'first_apply_tick',s.first_apply_tick, ...
    'no_random_sampling',true,'no_external_force',true, ...
    'scope','SOURCE_COMPONENT_REQUIRES_ROOT_EXACT_CLIP_GAIN_QUEUE_RESET_ADMISSION');
end

function report=audit_own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,witnessPath,outFile)
% ROOT-only finite SOURCE matrix diagnostic, no contacts/simulator/model.
% Numerical consistency flags apply to this function, not new robot guards.
assert(~isfile(outFile),'Preserve prior matrix diagnostic');
C=jsondecode(fileread(contractPath));G=jsondecode(fileread(geometryPath));W=jsondecode(fileread(witnessPath));
names=cellstr(string(W.joint_names));labels={'extension','tuck'};rows=cell(2,1);
for k=1:2
    q=W.(labels{k}).row.joint_pos30(:);
    s=struct('p',zeros(3,1),'R',eye(3),'v',zeros(3,1),'w',zeros(3,1),'q',q,'dq',zeros(30,1));
    d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);
    eigenvalues=eig((d.M+d.M')/2);
    % Nonrandom direction exercises all joints without consuming RNG.
    s.v=[.11;-.07;.03];s.w=[.02;.1;-.03];s.dq=linspace(-.1,.1,30)';
    moving=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);velocity=[s.v;s.w;s.dq];
    dt=1e-4;sp=s;sm=s;A=skew(s.w);
    sp.q=s.q+dt*s.dq;sm.q=s.q-dt*s.dq;
    sp.p=s.p+dt*s.v;sm.p=s.p-dt*s.v;
    sp.R=expm(dt*A)*s.R;sm.R=expm(-dt*A)*s.R;
    plus=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,sp);minus=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,sm);
    fdVelocity=(plus.loop_phi-minus.loop_phi)/(2*dt);
    fdBias=(plus.loop_phi-2*moving.loop_phi+minus.loop_phi)/(dt*dt);
    rows{k}=struct('pose',labels{k},'mass_kg',d.total_mass_kg,'COM',d.COM, ...
        'mass_matrix_finite',all(isfinite(d.M(:))),'symmetry_error_fro',norm(d.M-d.M','fro'), ...
        'mass_matrix_min_eigenvalue',min(eigenvalues),'gravity_base_force',d.h(1:3), ...
        'expected_gravity_base_force',[0;0;d.total_mass_kg*9.81], ...
        'static_closure_vector',d.loop_phi,'moving_kinetic_J',moving.kinetic_energy_J, ...
        'loop_J_velocity_fd_max_error',max(abs(moving.loop_J*velocity-fdVelocity)), ...
        'loop_Jdot_velocity_fd_max_error',max(abs(moving.loop_Jdot_velocity-fdBias)), ...
        'full_dynamics_contact_teacher_verified',false);
end
report=struct('schema','mod4.own.tree_dynamics_matrix_audit.v1','status','SOURCE_MATRIX_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY', ...
    'rows',{rows},'physical_teacher_valid',false,'source_mjcf_sha256',C.source_mjcf_sha256);
f=fopen(outFile,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));
fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(report,PrettyPrint=true));
end
function A=skew(v),v=v(:);A=[0 -v(3) v(2);v(3) 0 -v(1);-v(2) v(1) 0];end

function result=optimize_mod4_teacher_actions_v1(simulator,seedKnots,knotTimes,outDir,protocol)
% ROOT-only action6 shooting through a separately admitted full own simulator.
% This function NEVER writes states, impulses, forces, policy or neural weights.
% Contact/PD/queue/guards must be implemented by the ROOT-pinned simulator.
assert(isa(simulator,'function_handle'));
assert(strcmp(protocol.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
assert(strcmp(protocol.backend_admission,'ROOT_ADMITTED_EXACT_OWN_FULL_DYNAMICS'));

assert(all(abs(seedKnots(:))<=6) && all(isfinite(seedKnots(:))));
assert(isfield(protocol,'max_unique_rollouts') && protocol.max_unique_rollouts>0);
free=find(knotTimes>2 & knotTimes<20);assert(~isempty(free));
x0=seedKnots(free,:);x0=x0(:);records={};cache=containers.Map('KeyType','char','ValueType','any');
count=0;best=[];started=tic;op=optimoptions('fmincon','Algorithm','sqp','Display','iter', ...
    'MaxIterations',protocol.max_iterations,'MaxFunctionEvaluations',protocol.max_unique_rollouts);
try
    [x,J,flag,output]=fmincon(@objective,x0,[],[],[],[],-6*ones(size(x0)),6*ones(size(x0)),@constraints,op);
    final=evaluate(x);
    result=struct('status','ACTION6_SHOOTING_RETURNED_CANDIDATE_NOT_VALIDATED_TEACHER', ...
        'exitflag',flag,'output',output,'objective',J,'final_attempt',final,'unique_rollouts',count, ...
        'best_observed',best,'physical_teacher_valid',false,'training_ingestion_allowed',false);
catch ME
    result=struct('status','ORIGINAL_SOLVER_ERROR_OR_BOUND_RETAINED','identifier',ME.identifier, ...
        'message',ME.message,'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'), ...
        'unique_rollouts',count,'best_observed',best,'physical_teacher_valid',false,'training_ingestion_allowed',false);
end
result.protocol=protocol;result.all_attempts=records;writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'SOLVER_RETURNED_ACTUAL.json'),result);
    function value=objective(x)
        row=evaluate(x);value=row.action_squared_integral;
    end
    function [c,eq]=constraints(x)
        row=evaluate(x);c=row.continuous_inequalities(:);eq=row.equalities(:);
    end
    function row=evaluate(x)
        key=sprintf('%.17g,',x);
        if isKey(cache,key),row=cache(key);return;end
        assert(count<protocol.max_unique_rollouts,'Unique-rollout budget reached; preserve all observed attempts');
        assert(toc(started)<protocol.max_wall_seconds,'Explicit ROOT solver wall budget reached');
        knots=seedKnots;knots(free,:)=reshape(x,numel(free),6);
        time=(0:1999)'*.01;actions=interp1(knotTimes,knots,time,'linear');
        assert(all(isfinite(actions(:))) && all(abs(actions(:))<=6+1e-12));
        % The t=2 knot and every earlier knot remain fixed; all <200 control
        % values are identical across optimizer trials. No reset rewriting.
        count=count+1;attemptID=sprintf('%s_ROLLOUT_%06d',protocol.purpose_id,count);
        attemptProtocol=protocol;attemptProtocol.attempt_id=attemptID;
        try
        t=simulator(actions,attemptProtocol);
        assert(strcmp(t.source_mjcf_sha256,protocol.source_mjcf_sha256));
        assert(t.original_guards_unmodified && t.no_state_or_external_force_override);
        assert(t.dt==.0025 && t.controls<=2000 && t.callbacks<=8000);
        assert(isfield(t,'producer_manifest') && isfield(t,'continuous_inequalities') && isfield(t,'equalities'));
        assert(all(isfinite(t.continuous_inequalities(:))) && all(isfinite(t.equalities(:))));
        % Continuous geometry/velocity constraints guide search; original
        % physical success/termination is separately retained without relabel.
        row=struct('attempt_id',attemptID,'action_knots',knots,'knot_times',knotTimes, ...
            'action_squared_integral',.01*sum(actions(:).^2), ...
            'continuous_inequalities',t.continuous_inequalities,'equalities',t.equalities, ...
            'original_success',t.original_success,'original_termination',t.original_termination, ...
            'producer_manifest',t.producer_manifest,'unvalidated_for_original_PhysX',true);
        writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,[attemptID '_ACTUAL.json']),row);

                'action_knots',knots,'knot_times',knotTimes,'protocol',attemptProtocol, ...
                'identifier',ME.identifier,'message',ME.message, ...
                'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'),'physical_teacher_valid',false);
            writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,[attemptID '_ORIGINAL_ERROR_ACTUAL.json']),failure);
            records{end+1}=failure;rethrow(ME);
        end
    end
end
function yes=better(a,b)
% Literal report ordering; no new robot reward weights.
if a.original_success~=b.original_success,yes=a.original_success;return;end
av=sum(max(0,a.continuous_inequalities(:)).^2)+sum(a.equalities(:).^2);
bv=sum(max(0,b.continuous_inequalities(:)).^2)+sum(b.equalities(:).^2);
if av~=bv,yes=av<bv;else,yes=a.action_squared_integral<b.action_squared_integral;end
end
function writeJSON(path,value)
assert(~isfile(path),'Preserve original report');f=fopen(path,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);
cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(value,PrettyPrint=true));
end

function d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,state,parameters)
% Own floating-base36-velocity tree M,h and6 closure+mimic constraints.
% Generalized velocity = [root linear WORLD3; root angular WORLD3; dq30].
% M*a+h = B*tau6 + gas + Jloop'*lambda + Jcontact'*contact_impulses/dt.
% This is a SOURCE dynamics component, NOT a contact simulator or teacher.
% ROOT must validate with exact MJCF/PhysX before any trajectory is trusted.
if nargin<5,parameters=struct;end
assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
bn=cellstr(string(G.body_names));names=cellstr(string(names));N=36;nb=31;
assert(numel(names)==30 && numel(bn)==nb);
q=state.q(:);dq=state.dq(:);assert(numel(q)==30 && numel(dq)==30);
P=zeros(3,nb);R=zeros(3,3,nb);V=P;W=P;ab=P;alphab=P;
Jv=zeros(3,N,nb);Jw=Jv;
P(:,1)=state.p(:);R(:,:,1)=state.R;V(:,1)=state.v(:);W(:,1)=state.w(:);
Jv(:,1:3,1)=eye(3);Jw(:,4:6,1)=eye(3);
jn=fieldnames(C.joints);childMap=containers.Map;
for j=1:numel(jn),childMap(C.joints.(jn{j}).child)=jn{j};end
for b=2:nb
    name=childMap(bn{b});r=C.joints.(name);par=find(strcmp(bn,r.parent),1);
    assert(par<b);j=find(strcmp(names,name),1);a=q(j);ad=dq(j);
    A=R(:,:,par)*qm(r.local_rot0);axis=A(:,1);anchor=R(:,:,par)*r.local_pos0(:);
    if strcmp(r.type,'hinge')
        RX=[1 0 0;0 cos(a) -sin(a);0 sin(a) cos(a)];R(:,:,b)=A*RX*qm(r.local_rot1)';
        offset=R(:,:,b)*r.local_pos1(:);P(:,b)=P(:,par)+anchor-offset;
        W(:,b)=W(:,par)+axis*ad;
        V(:,b)=V(:,par)+cross(W(:,par),anchor)-cross(W(:,b),offset);
        Jw(:,:,b)=Jw(:,:,par);Jw(:,6+j,b)=Jw(:,6+j,b)+axis;
        Jv(:,:,b)=Jv(:,:,par)-skew(anchor)*Jw(:,:,par)+skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,b);
        alphab(:,b)=alphab(:,par)+cross(W(:,par),axis*ad);
        ab(:,b)=ab(:,par)+cross(alphab(:,par),anchor)+cross(W(:,par),cross(W(:,par),anchor)) ...
            -cross(alphab(:,b),offset)-cross(W(:,b),cross(W(:,b),offset));
    elseif strcmp(r.type,'slide')
        R(:,:,b)=A*qm(r.local_rot1)';offset=anchor+axis*a-R(:,:,b)*r.local_pos1(:);
        P(:,b)=P(:,par)+offset;W(:,b)=W(:,par);
        V(:,b)=V(:,par)+cross(W(:,par),offset)+axis*ad;
        Jw(:,:,b)=Jw(:,:,par);Jv(:,:,b)=Jv(:,:,par)-skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,par);
        Jv(:,6+j,b)=Jv(:,6+j,b)+axis;
        alphab(:,b)=alphab(:,par);
        ab(:,b)=ab(:,par)+cross(alphab(:,par),offset)+cross(W(:,par),cross(W(:,par),offset)) ...
            +2*cross(W(:,par),axis*ad);
    else,error('Exact own hinge/slide tree only');end
end
M=zeros(N);h=zeros(N,1);gravity=[0;0;-9.81];totalMass=0;comWeighted=zeros(3,1);
comJ=zeros(3,N);comAccelerationBias=zeros(3,1);
for b=1:nb
    body=C.bodies.(bn{b});m=body.mass_kg;localCOM=body.com_m(:);
    if isfield(parameters,'body_mass31'),m=parameters.body_mass31(b);end
    if isfield(parameters,'body_COM3x31'),localCOM=parameters.body_COM3x31(:,b);end
    assert(m>0);offset=R(:,:,b)*localCOM;
    pc=P(:,b)+offset;JV=Jv(:,:,b)-skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,b);JW=Jw(:,:,b);
    principal=qm(body.principal_axes_wxyz);
    Ibody=principal*diag(body.diagonal_inertia_kg_m2)*principal';
    if isfield(parameters,'body_inertia_COM3x3x31'),Ibody=parameters.body_inertia_COM3x3x31(:,:,b);end
    I=R(:,:,b)*Ibody*R(:,:,b)';
    aCOM=ab(:,b)+cross(alphab(:,b),offset)+cross(W(:,b),cross(W(:,b),offset));
    M=M+m*(JV'*JV)+JW'*I*JW;
    h=h+JV'*(m*(aCOM-gravity))+JW'*(I*alphab(:,b)+cross(W(:,b),I*W(:,b)));
    totalMass=totalMass+m;comWeighted=comWeighted+m*pc;
    comJ=comJ+m*JV;comAccelerationBias=comAccelerationBias+m*aCOM;
end
armature=zeros(30,1);passiveDamping=armature;
for j=1:30
    row=C.joints.(names{j});armature(j)=row.armature;passiveDamping(j)=row.damping_si;
end
actNames={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'};
[ok,act]=ismember(actNames,names);assert(all(ok));gasNames=fieldnames(C.gas_springs);
[ok,gas]=ismember(gasNames,names);assert(all(ok));
% Actual source explicit motor PD requires implicit motor drives to be zero.
% Gas damping is included ONCE inside the capped gas force, not again in h.
passiveDamping([act(:);gas(:)])=0;

if isfield(parameters,'passive_joint_damping30'),passiveDamping=parameters.passive_joint_damping30(:);end
assert(numel(armature)==30 && numel(passiveDamping)==30 && all(armature>=0) && all(passiveDamping>=0));
M(7:36,7:36)=M(7:36,7:36)+diag(armature);h(7:36)=h(7:36)+passiveDamping.*dq;
B=zeros(N,6);for j=1:6,B(6+act(j),j)=1;end
Fgas=zeros(N,1);gasRows=cell(2,1);

    row=C.gas_springs.(gasNames{k});stiffness=row.stiffness_n_m;damping=row.damping_n_s_m;
    target=row.target_position_m;cap=400;
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_k2'),stiffness=parameters.gas_k2(k);end
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_c2'),damping=parameters.gas_c2(k);end
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_target2'),target=parameters.gas_target2(k);end
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_cap2'),cap=parameters.gas_cap2(k);end
    assert(cap==400 && stiffness>0 && damping>=0,'No source force-cap expansion');
    requested=stiffness*(target-q(gas(k)))-damping*dq(gas(k));
    force=max(-cap,min(cap,requested));Fgas(6+gas(k))=force;
    gasRows{k}=struct('name',gasNames{k},'force_N',force,'requested_N',requested,'k',stiffness,'c',damping,'target',target);
end
cn=fieldnames(C.closures);phi=[];J=[];bias=[];
for k=1:numel(cn)
    row=C.closures.(cn{k});b0=find(strcmp(bn,row.body0));b1=find(strcmp(bn,row.body1));
    [x0,j0,a0]=point(b0,row.anchor0_m);[x1,j1,a1]=point(b1,row.anchor1_m);
    phi=[phi;x0-x1];J=[J;j0-j1];bias=[bias;a0-a1]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
mn=fieldnames(C.mimics);
for k=1:numel(mn)
    row=C.mimics.(mn{k});j=find(strcmp(names,mn{k}));r=find(strcmp(names,row.reference_joint));
    jr=zeros(1,N);jr(6+j)=1;jr(6+r)=row.gearing;
    phi=[phi;q(j)+row.gearing*q(r)+row.offset];J=[J;jr];bias=[bias;0]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
velocity=[state.v(:);state.w(:);dq];
d=struct('M',M,'h',h,'B_action_torque_order6',B,'gas_generalized_force',Fgas,'gas',{gasRows}, ...
    'loop_phi',phi,'loop_J',J,'loop_Jdot_velocity',bias,'loop_velocity',J*velocity, ...
    'body_position',P,'body_rotation',R,'body_velocity',V,'body_angular_velocity',W, ...
    'body_origin_Jv',Jv,'body_Jw',Jw,'body_origin_acceleration_bias',ab,'body_angular_acceleration_bias',alphab, ...
    'total_mass_kg',totalMass,'COM',comWeighted/totalMass,'kinetic_energy_J',.5*velocity'*M*velocity, ...
    'COM_Jv',comJ/totalMass,'COM_acceleration_bias',comAccelerationBias/totalMass, ...
    'armature30',armature,'passive_damping30',passiveDamping,'actuation_order',{actNames}, ...
    'scope','SOURCE_TREE_DYNAMICS_COMPONENT_NO_CONTACT_SOLVER_NO_TEACHER_VALIDATION');
    function [x,j,a]=point(b,local)
        offset=R(:,:,b)*local(:);x=P(:,b)+offset;
        j=Jv(:,:,b)-skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,b);
        a=ab(:,b)+cross(alphab(:,b),offset)+cross(W(:,b),cross(W(:,b),offset));
    end

function R=qm(q)

2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x); ...

end

function a=solve_own_loop_acceleration_v1(d,tau6,rankRelativeTolerance)
% No-contact instantaneous acceleration with original internal gas retained.
% No Baumgarte state force, no body force, no unmeasured contact is introduced.
% Redundant equations remain in full residual diagnostics.
if nargin<3,rankRelativeTolerance=1e-9;end
assert(numel(tau6)==6 && all(isfinite(tau6(:))));
J=d.loop_J;[~,RR,pivot]=qr(J','vector');diagonal=abs(diag(RR));
rankTolerance=rankRelativeTolerance*max([diagonal;1]);r=sum(diagonal>rankTolerance);selected=pivot(1:r);
JR=J(selected,:);b=d.loop_Jdot_velocity(selected);
force=d.B_action_torque_order6*tau6(:)+d.gas_generalized_force-d.h;
K=[d.M,-JR';JR,zeros(r)];rhs=[force;-b];solution=K\rhs;
acc=solution(1:36);lambda=zeros(size(J,1),1);lambda(selected)=solution(37:end);
a=struct('generalized_acceleration',acc,'loop_lambda',lambda,'selected_row_indices',selected, ...
    'selected_rank',r,'numerical_rank_relative_tolerance',rankRelativeTolerance, ...
    'full_loop_acceleration_defect',J*acc+d.loop_Jdot_velocity, ...
    'dynamics_defect',d.M*acc+d.h-d.B_action_torque_order6*tau6(:)-d.gas_generalized_force-J'*lambda, ...
    'COM_acceleration',d.COM_Jv*acc+d.COM_acceleration_bias, ...
    'expected_free_COM_acceleration',[0;0;-9.81],'KKT_rcond',rcond(K), ...
    'finite',all(isfinite(solution)),'no_contact_no_external_force',true, ...
    'scope','SOURCE_INSTANTANEOUS_NO_CONTACT_CONSISTENCY_NOT_TEACHER_SIMULATION');
end

function report=test_own_no_contact_dynamics_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,witnessPath,outFile)
% ROOT-only minimal executable M/h/J/gas closed-loop no-contact test.
% Source matrices and instantaneous accelerations only; no engine/model load.
assert(~isfile(outFile),'Preserve consumed original output');
C=jsondecode(fileread(contractPath));G=jsondecode(fileread(geometryPath));W=jsondecode(fileread(witnessPath));
assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
names=cellstr(string(W.joint_names));labels={'extension','tuck'};rows=cell(2,1);
try
for k=1:2
    q=W.(labels{k}).row.joint_pos30(:);
    s=struct('p',[0;0;1],'R',eye(3),'v',zeros(3,1),'w',zeros(3,1),'q',q,'dq',zeros(30,1));
    d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);
    solved=solve_own_loop_acceleration_v1(d,zeros(6,1));
    symmetry=norm(d.M-d.M','fro');eigenvalues=eig((d.M+d.M')/2);
    defect=max(abs(solved.full_loop_acceleration_defect));
    comError=max(abs(solved.COM_acceleration-[0;0;-9.81]));
    rows{k}=struct('pose',labels{k},'mass_kg',d.total_mass_kg,'nominal_internal_gas',{d.gas}, ...
        'initial_phi',d.loop_phi,'mass_matrix_symmetry_error',symmetry, ...
        'mass_matrix_min_eigenvalue',min(eigenvalues),'solved',solved, ...
        'source_consistency_flags',struct('finite',solved.finite,'positive_mass_matrix',min(eigenvalues)>0, ...
            'full_acceleration_equations_near_zero',defect<1e-5,'free_COM_follows_gravity',comError<1e-6), ...
        'physical_teacher_valid',false);
end
report=struct('schema','mod4.own.no_contact_dynamics_test.v1','status','RETURNED_SOURCE_CONSISTENCY_DIAGNOSTICS', ...
    'rows',{rows},'contact_engine_calls',0,'model_loads',0,'SDK_calls',0,'physical_teacher_valid',false);
catch ME
report=struct('schema','mod4.own.no_contact_dynamics_test.v1','status','ORIGINAL_SOURCE_ERROR_NOT_RETRIED', ...
    'identifier',ME.identifier,'message',ME.message,'stack',ME.stack,'completed_rows',{rows}, ...
    'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'),'physical_teacher_valid',false);
end
f=fopen(outFile,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));
fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(report,PrettyPrint=true));
end

function report=audit_own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,witnessPath,outFile)
% ROOT-only finite SOURCE matrix diagnostic, no contacts/simulator/model.
% Numerical consistency flags apply to this function, not new robot guards.
assert(~isfile(outFile),'Preserve prior matrix diagnostic');
C=jsondecode(fileread(contractPath));G=jsondecode(fileread(geometryPath));W=jsondecode(fileread(witnessPath));
names=cellstr(string(W.joint_names));labels={'extension','tuck'};rows=cell(2,1);
for k=1:2
    q=W.(labels{k}).row.joint_pos30(:);
    s=struct('p',zeros(3,1),'R',eye(3),'v',zeros(3,1),'w',zeros(3,1),'q',q,'dq',zeros(30,1));
    d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);
    eigenvalues=eig((d.M+d.M')/2);
    % Nonrandom direction exercises all joints without consuming RNG.
    s.v=[.11;-.07;.03];s.w=[.02;.1;-.03];s.dq=linspace(-.1,.1,30)';
    moving=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);velocity=[s.v;s.w;s.dq];
    dt=1e-4;sp=s;sm=s;A=skew(s.w);
    sp.q=s.q+dt*s.dq;sm.q=s.q-dt*s.dq;
    sp.p=s.p+dt*s.v;sm.p=s.p-dt*s.v;
    sp.R=expm(dt*A)*s.R;sm.R=expm(-dt*A)*s.R;
    plus=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,sp);minus=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,sm);
    fdVelocity=(plus.loop_phi-minus.loop_phi)/(2*dt);
    fdBias=(plus.loop_phi-2*moving.loop_phi+minus.loop_phi)/(dt*dt);
    rows{k}=struct('pose',labels{k},'mass_kg',d.total_mass_kg,'COM',d.COM, ...
        'mass_matrix_finite',all(isfinite(d.M(:))),'symmetry_error_fro',norm(d.M-d.M','fro'), ...
        'mass_matrix_min_eigenvalue',min(eigenvalues),'gravity_base_force',d.h(1:3), ...
        'expected_gravity_base_force',[0;0;d.total_mass_kg*9.81], ...
        'static_closure_vector',d.loop_phi,'moving_kinetic_J',moving.kinetic_energy_J, ...
        'loop_J_velocity_fd_max_error',max(abs(moving.loop_J*velocity-fdVelocity)), ...
        'loop_Jdot_velocity_fd_max_error',max(abs(moving.loop_Jdot_velocity-fdBias)), ...
        'full_dynamics_contact_teacher_verified',false);
end
report=struct('schema','mod4.own.tree_dynamics_matrix_audit.v1','status','SOURCE_MATRIX_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY', ...
    'rows',{rows},'physical_teacher_valid',false,'source_mjcf_sha256',C.source_mjcf_sha256);
f=fopen(outFile,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));
fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(report,PrettyPrint=true));
end
function A=skew(v),v=v(:);A=[0 -v(3) v(2);v(3) 0 -v(1);-v(2) v(1) 0];end

        U=lambda q:.5*k*(target-q)**2

        old_full=400*(qhi-qlo);old_W=400*(qe-qt)
        assert 0<F(qhi,0)<401 and 494<F(qlo,0)<495 and work>old_full and actual_W_work>old_W
        assert F(qhi,-1000)==2000 and F(qhi,1000)==-2000

            nominal_extension_reference_N=400,authored_q_interval_m=[qlo,qhi],authored_stroke_m=qhi-qlo,
            native_static_force_at_limits_N=[F(qlo,0),F(qhi,0)],

        for q in (qlo,(qlo+qhi)/2,qhi):

function d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,state,parameters)
% Own floating-base36-velocity tree M,h and6 closure+mimic constraints.
% Generalized velocity = [root linear WORLD3; root angular WORLD3; dq30].
% M*a+h = B*tau6 + gas + Jloop'*lambda + Jcontact'*contact_impulses/dt.
% This is a SOURCE dynamics component, NOT a contact simulator or teacher.
% ROOT must validate with exact MJCF/PhysX before any trajectory is trusted.
if nargin<5,parameters=struct;end
assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
bn=cellstr(string(G.body_names));names=cellstr(string(names));N=36;nb=31;
assert(numel(names)==30 && numel(bn)==nb);
q=state.q(:);dq=state.dq(:);assert(numel(q)==30 && numel(dq)==30);
P=zeros(3,nb);R=zeros(3,3,nb);V=P;W=P;ab=P;alphab=P;
Jv=zeros(3,N,nb);Jw=Jv;
P(:,1)=state.p(:);R(:,:,1)=state.R;V(:,1)=state.v(:);W(:,1)=state.w(:);
Jv(:,1:3,1)=eye(3);Jw(:,4:6,1)=eye(3);
jn=fieldnames(C.joints);childMap=containers.Map;
for j=1:numel(jn),childMap(C.joints.(jn{j}).child)=jn{j};end
for b=2:nb
    name=childMap(bn{b});r=C.joints.(name);par=find(strcmp(bn,r.parent),1);
    assert(par<b);j=find(strcmp(names,name),1);a=q(j);ad=dq(j);
    A=R(:,:,par)*qm(r.local_rot0);axis=A(:,1);anchor=R(:,:,par)*r.local_pos0(:);
    if strcmp(r.type,'hinge')
        RX=[1 0 0;0 cos(a) -sin(a);0 sin(a) cos(a)];R(:,:,b)=A*RX*qm(r.local_rot1)';
        offset=R(:,:,b)*r.local_pos1(:);P(:,b)=P(:,par)+anchor-offset;
        W(:,b)=W(:,par)+axis*ad;
        V(:,b)=V(:,par)+cross(W(:,par),anchor)-cross(W(:,b),offset);
        Jw(:,:,b)=Jw(:,:,par);Jw(:,6+j,b)=Jw(:,6+j,b)+axis;
        Jv(:,:,b)=Jv(:,:,par)-skew(anchor)*Jw(:,:,par)+skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,b);
        alphab(:,b)=alphab(:,par)+cross(W(:,par),axis*ad);
        ab(:,b)=ab(:,par)+cross(alphab(:,par),anchor)+cross(W(:,par),cross(W(:,par),anchor)) ...
            -cross(alphab(:,b),offset)-cross(W(:,b),cross(W(:,b),offset));
    elseif strcmp(r.type,'slide')
        R(:,:,b)=A*qm(r.local_rot1)';offset=anchor+axis*a-R(:,:,b)*r.local_pos1(:);
        P(:,b)=P(:,par)+offset;W(:,b)=W(:,par);
        V(:,b)=V(:,par)+cross(W(:,par),offset)+axis*ad;
        Jw(:,:,b)=Jw(:,:,par);Jv(:,:,b)=Jv(:,:,par)-skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,par);
        Jv(:,6+j,b)=Jv(:,6+j,b)+axis;
        alphab(:,b)=alphab(:,par);
        ab(:,b)=ab(:,par)+cross(alphab(:,par),offset)+cross(W(:,par),cross(W(:,par),offset)) ...
            +2*cross(W(:,par),axis*ad);
    else,error('Exact own hinge/slide tree only');end
end
M=zeros(N);h=zeros(N,1);gravity=[0;0;-9.81];totalMass=0;comWeighted=zeros(3,1);
comJ=zeros(3,N);comAccelerationBias=zeros(3,1);
for b=1:nb
    body=C.bodies.(bn{b});m=body.mass_kg;localCOM=body.com_m(:);
    if isfield(parameters,'body_mass31'),m=parameters.body_mass31(b);end
    if isfield(parameters,'body_COM3x31'),localCOM=parameters.body_COM3x31(:,b);end
    assert(m>0);offset=R(:,:,b)*localCOM;
    pc=P(:,b)+offset;JV=Jv(:,:,b)-skew(offset)*Jw(:,:,b);JW=Jw(:,:,b);
    principal=qm(body.principal_axes_wxyz);
    Ibody=principal*diag(body.diagonal_inertia_kg_m2)*principal';
    if isfield(parameters,'body_inertia_COM3x3x31'),Ibody=parameters.body_inertia_COM3x3x31(:,:,b);end
    I=R(:,:,b)*Ibody*R(:,:,b)';
    aCOM=ab(:,b)+cross(alphab(:,b),offset)+cross(W(:,b),cross(W(:,b),offset));
    M=M+m*(JV'*JV)+JW'*I*JW;
    h=h+JV'*(m*(aCOM-gravity))+JW'*(I*alphab(:,b)+cross(W(:,b),I*W(:,b)));
    totalMass=totalMass+m;comWeighted=comWeighted+m*pc;
    comJ=comJ+m*JV;comAccelerationBias=comAccelerationBias+m*aCOM;
end
armature=zeros(30,1);passiveDamping=armature;
for j=1:30
    row=C.joints.(names{j});armature(j)=row.armature;passiveDamping(j)=row.damping_si;
end
actNames={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'};
[ok,act]=ismember(actNames,names);assert(all(ok));gasNames=fieldnames(C.gas_springs);
[ok,gas]=ismember(gasNames,names);assert(all(ok));
% Actual source explicit motor PD requires implicit motor drives to be zero.
% Gas damping is included ONCE inside the capped gas force, not again in h.
passiveDamping([act(:);gas(:)])=0;
if isfield(parameters,'joint_armature30'),armature=parameters.joint_armature30(:);end
if isfield(parameters,'passive_joint_damping30'),passiveDamping=parameters.passive_joint_damping30(:);end
assert(numel(armature)==30 && numel(passiveDamping)==30 && all(armature>=0) && all(passiveDamping>=0));
M(7:36,7:36)=M(7:36,7:36)+diag(armature);h(7:36)=h(7:36)+passiveDamping.*dq;
B=zeros(N,6);for j=1:6,B(6+act(j),j)=1;end
Fgas=zeros(N,1);gasRows=cell(2,1);

    row=C.gas_springs.(gasNames{k});stiffness=row.stiffness_n_m;damping=row.damping_n_s_m;
    target=row.target_position_m;cap=2000;
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_k2'),stiffness=parameters.gas_k2(k);end
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_c2'),damping=parameters.gas_c2(k);end
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_target2'),target=parameters.gas_target2(k);end
    if isfield(parameters,'gas_cap2'),cap=parameters.gas_cap2(k);end
    assert(cap==2000 && stiffness>0 && damping>=0,'Original source implicit effort_limit_sim must remain2000N;400N is nominal only');
    requested=stiffness*(target-q(gas(k)))-damping*dq(gas(k));
    force=max(-cap,min(cap,requested));Fgas(6+gas(k))=force;
    gasRows{k}=struct('name',gasNames{k},'force_N',force,'requested_N',requested,'effort_limit_sim_N',cap,'nominal_extended_force_N',400,'k',stiffness,'c',damping,'target',target);
end
cn=fieldnames(C.closures);phi=[];J=[];bias=[];
for k=1:numel(cn)
    row=C.closures.(cn{k});b0=find(strcmp(bn,row.body0));b1=find(strcmp(bn,row.body1));
    [x0,j0,a0]=point(b0,row.anchor0_m);[x1,j1,a1]=point(b1,row.anchor1_m);
    phi=[phi;x0-x1];J=[J;j0-j1];bias=[bias;a0-a1]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
mn=fieldnames(C.mimics);
for k=1:numel(mn)
    row=C.mimics.(mn{k});j=find(strcmp(names,mn{k}));r=find(strcmp(names,row.reference_joint));
    jr=zeros(1,N);jr(6+j)=1;jr(6+r)=row.gearing;
    phi=[phi;q(j)+row.gearing*q(r)+row.offset];J=[J;jr];bias=[bias;0]; %#ok<AGROW>

velocity=[state.v(:);state.w(:);dq];
d=struct('M',M,'h',h,'B_action_torque_order6',B,'gas_generalized_force',Fgas,'gas',{gasRows}, ...
    'loop_phi',phi,'loop_J',J,'loop_Jdot_velocity',bias,'loop_velocity',J*velocity, ...

    'body_origin_Jv',Jv,'body_Jw',Jw,'body_origin_acceleration_bias',ab,'body_angular_acceleration_bias',alphab, ...

    'COM_Jv',comJ/totalMass,'COM_acceleration_bias',comAccelerationBias/totalMass, ...
    'armature30',armature,'passive_damping30',passiveDamping,'actuation_order',{actNames}, ...
    'scope','SOURCE_TREE_DYNAMICS_COMPONENT_NO_CONTACT_SOLVER_NO_TEACHER_VALIDATION');

        a=ab(:,b)+cross(alphab(:,b),offset)+cross(W(:,b),cross(W(:,b),offset));

function R=qm(q)

2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x); ...

function a=solve_own_loop_acceleration_v1(d,tau6,rankRelativeTolerance)
% No-contact instantaneous acceleration with original internal gas retained.
% No Baumgarte state force, no body force, no unmeasured contact is introduced.
% Redundant equations remain in full residual diagnostics.
if nargin<3,rankRelativeTolerance=1e-9;end
assert(numel(tau6)==6 && all(isfinite(tau6(:))));
J=d.loop_J;[~,RR,pivot]=qr(J','vector');diagonal=abs(diag(RR));
rankTolerance=rankRelativeTolerance*max([diagonal;1]);r=sum(diagonal>rankTolerance);selected=pivot(1:r);
JR=J(selected,:);b=d.loop_Jdot_velocity(selected);
force=d.B_action_torque_order6*tau6(:)+d.gas_generalized_force-d.h;
K=[d.M,-JR';JR,zeros(r)];rhs=[force;-b];solution=K\rhs;
acc=solution(1:36);lambda=zeros(size(J,1),1);lambda(selected)=solution(37:end);
a=struct('generalized_acceleration',acc,'loop_lambda',lambda,'selected_row_indices',selected, ...
    'selected_rank',r,'numerical_rank_relative_tolerance',rankRelativeTolerance, ...
    'full_loop_acceleration_defect',J*acc+d.loop_Jdot_velocity, ...
    'dynamics_defect',d.M*acc+d.h-d.B_action_torque_order6*tau6(:)-d.gas_generalized_force-J'*lambda, ...
    'COM_acceleration',d.COM_Jv*acc+d.COM_acceleration_bias, ...

function report=test_own_no_contact_dynamics_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,witnessPath,outFile)
% ROOT-only minimal executable M/h/J/gas closed-loop no-contact test.
% Source matrices and instantaneous accelerations only; no engine/model load.
assert(~isfile(outFile),'Preserve consumed original output');
C=jsondecode(fileread(contractPath));G=jsondecode(fileread(geometryPath));W=jsondecode(fileread(witnessPath));
assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
names=cellstr(string(W.joint_names));labels={'extension','tuck'};rows=cell(2,1);
try
for k=1:2
    q=W.(labels{k}).row.joint_pos30(:);
    s=struct('p',[0;0;1],'R',eye(3),'v',zeros(3,1),'w',zeros(3,1),'q',q,'dq',zeros(30,1));
    d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);
    solved=solve_own_loop_acceleration_v1(d,zeros(6,1));
    symmetry=norm(d.M-d.M','fro');eigenvalues=eig((d.M+d.M')/2);
    defect=max(abs(solved.full_loop_acceleration_defect));
    comError=max(abs(solved.COM_acceleration-[0;0;-9.81]));
    rows{k}=struct('pose',labels{k},'mass_kg',d.total_mass_kg,'nominal_internal_gas',{d.gas}, ...
        'initial_phi',d.loop_phi,'mass_matrix_symmetry_error',symmetry, ...
        'mass_matrix_min_eigenvalue',min(eigenvalues),'solved',solved, ...
        'source_consistency_flags',struct('finite',solved.finite,'positive_mass_matrix',min(eigenvalues)>0, ...
            'full_acceleration_equations_near_zero',defect<1e-5,'free_COM_follows_gravity',comError<1e-6), ...
        'physical_teacher_valid',false);
end
report=struct('schema','mod4.own.no_contact_dynamics_test.v1','status','RETURNED_SOURCE_CONSISTENCY_DIAGNOSTICS', ...
    'rows',{rows},'contact_engine_calls',0,'model_loads',0,'SDK_calls',0,'physical_teacher_valid',false);
catch ME
report=struct('schema','mod4.own.no_contact_dynamics_test.v1','status','ORIGINAL_SOURCE_ERROR_NOT_RETRIED', ...
    'identifier',ME.identifier,'message',ME.message,'stack',ME.stack,'completed_rows',{rows}, ...
    'full_report',getReport(ME,'extended','hyperlinks','off'),'physical_teacher_valid',false);
end
f=fopen(outFile,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));
fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(report,PrettyPrint=true));
end

function g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q,p,R)
% Own imported30-joint tree + authored shapes. Kinematics, not dynamics.
% No ideal linkage substitution; every passive/mimic/slide q is represented.
if nargin<5, p=zeros(3,1); end
if nargin<6, R=eye(3); end
names=cellstr(string(names)); bn=cellstr(string(G.body_names)); q=q(:);
assert(numel(q)==30 && numel(names)==30 && numel(bn)==31);
assert(strcmp(bn{1},'chassis'));
P=zeros(3,31); B=zeros(3,3,31); P(:,1)=p(:); B(:,:,1)=R;
jn=fieldnames(C.joints); bychild=containers.Map;
for j=1:numel(jn), bychild(C.joints.(jn{j}).child)=jn{j}; end
for b=2:31
    name=bychild(bn{b}); row=C.joints.(name); parent=find(strcmp(bn,row.parent),1);
    assert(parent<b,'Imported own body order must be topological');
    a=q(strcmp(names,name)); assert(isscalar(a));
    A=B(:,:,parent)*qmat(row.local_rot0); axis=A(:,1);
    if strcmp(row.type,'hinge')
        motion=[1 0 0;0 cos(a) -sin(a);0 sin(a) cos(a)];
        B(:,:,b)=A*motion*qmat(row.local_rot1)';
        P(:,b)=P(:,parent)+B(:,:,parent)*row.local_pos0(:)-B(:,:,b)*row.local_pos1(:);
    elseif strcmp(row.type,'slide')
        B(:,:,b)=A*qmat(row.local_rot1)';
        P(:,b)=P(:,parent)+B(:,:,parent)*row.local_pos0(:)+axis*a-B(:,:,b)*row.local_pos1(:);
    else
        error('Only exact imported hinge/slide joints admitted');
    end
end
shapes=G.shapes; if isstruct(shapes), shapes=num2cell(shapes); end
lo=zeros(3,numel(shapes)); hi=lo; body=zeros(1,numel(shapes));
for s=1:numel(shapes)
    h=shapes{s}; b=find(strcmp(bn,h.body),1); body(s)=b;
    A=B(:,:,b)*h.linear_body_from_shape;
    centre=P(:,b)+B(:,:,b)*h.origin_body_m(:);
    switch h.type
        case 'Mesh'
            points=A*h.points'+centre;
            lo(:,s)=min(points,[],2); hi(:,s)=max(points,[],2);
        case 'Cube'
            radius=sum(abs(A),2)*h.size/2;
            lo(:,s)=centre-radius; hi(:,s)=centre+radius;
        case {'Cylinder','Capsule'}
            axis=double(h.axis)+1; radial=setdiff(1:3,axis);
            segment=abs(A(:,axis))*h.height/2;
            if strcmp(h.type,'Cylinder')
                radius=segment+h.radius*sqrt(sum(A(:,radial).^2,2));
            else
                radius=segment+h.radius*sqrt(sum(A.^2,2));
            end
            lo(:,s)=centre-radius; hi(:,s)=centre+radius;
        otherwise
            error('Unqualified authored shape kind');
    end
end
wl=zeros(3,2); wh=wl; wheelNames={'left_wheel','right_wheel'};
for k=1:2
    mask=body==find(strcmp(bn,wheelNames{k}),1);
    wl(:,k)=min(lo(:,mask),[],2); wh(:,k)=max(hi(:,mask),[],2);
end
mass=zeros(31,1); com=zeros(3,31);
for b=1:31
    row=C.bodies.(bn{b}); mass(b)=row.mass_kg;
    com(:,b)=P(:,b)+B(:,:,b)*row.com_m(:);
end
cn=fieldnames(C.closures); phi=zeros(3,numel(cn));
for i=1:numel(cn)
    c=C.closures.(cn{i}); a=find(strcmp(bn,c.body0),1); b=find(strcmp(bn,c.body1),1);
    phi(:,i)=P(:,a)+B(:,:,a)*c.anchor0_m(:)-P(:,b)-B(:,:,b)*c.anchor1_m(:);
end
mn=fieldnames(C.mimics); mimic=zeros(numel(mn),1);
for i=1:numel(mn)
    row=C.mimics.(mn{i}); j=find(strcmp(names,mn{i})); k=find(strcmp(names,row.reference_joint));
    % PhysX-style q_joint + gearing*q_reference + offset = 0 convention.
    % ROOT must confirm the exact MJCF/backend convention before dynamics use.
    mimic(i)=q(j)+row.gearing*q(k)+row.offset;
end
g=struct('body_names',{bn},'body_position',P,'body_rotation',B,'shape_low',lo,'shape_high',hi,
    'shape_body_index',body,'wheel_low',wl,'wheel_high',wh,'mass_kg',sum(mass),
    'body_COM',com,'COM',com*mass/sum(mass),'closure_residual',phi,
    'closure_max_m',max(sqrt(sum(phi.^2,1))),'mimic_residual',mimic,
    'constraint_vector',[phi(:);mimic(:)]);
end

function R=qmat(q)
q=q(:)/norm(q); w=q(1);x=q(2);y=q(3);z=q(4);
R=[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y); ...
   2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x); ...

function result=solve_mod4_teacher_seed_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,witnessPath,outDir,opts)
% Executable own-geometry/COM/energy + constrained flight SEED. NOT a teacher.
% ROOT invokes this in the existing MATLAB session. No app/SDK/model startup.
% Root/pose rows are REFERENCES ONLY: never play by writing simulated states.
if nargin<5, opts=struct; end
if ~isfield(opts,'startFront'),opts.startFront=-.20;end % design runway, not an actual reset
if ~isfield(opts,'muAssumed'),opts.muAssumed=.7;end     % engineering nominal mix; not measured
if ~isfield(opts,'runOptimization'),opts.runOptimization=true;end
if ~isfield(opts,'maxIterations'),opts.maxIterations=60;end
assert(~isfolder(outDir),'Use an exclusive NEW purpose output directory');mkdir(outDir);
[C,idC]=readBound(contractPath);[G,idG]=readBound(geometryPath);[W,idW]=readBound(witnessPath);
assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
names=cellstr(string(W.joint_names)); qE=W.extension.row.joint_pos30(:);qT=W.tuck.row.joint_pos30(:);
gE=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,qE);gT=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,qT);
mass=gE.mass_kg;grav=9.81;actNames={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip'};
act=findNames(names,actNames);wheel=findNames(names,{'left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'});
lb=-inf(30,1);ub=inf(30,1);
for j=1:30
    limits=C.joints.(names{j}).limits_si;
    if ~isempty(limits),lb(j)=limits(1);ub(j)=limits(2);end
end
gasNames=fieldnames(C.gas_springs);gasWork=0;gasStroke=zeros(2,1);
for j=1:2
    a=C.joints.(gasNames{j}).limits_si;gasStroke(j)=a(2)-a(1);
    assert(gasStroke(j)<=.060000001);gasWork=gasWork+400*gasStroke(j);
end
haveFmincon=exist('fmincon','file')==2 && license('test','Optimization_Toolbox');
result=struct('schema','mod4.own.teacher_matlab_seed.v1','status','KINEMATIC_SEED_ONLY_NOT_DYNAMICS_VALIDATED', ...
    'input_identity',struct('contract',idC,'geometry',idG,'witness',idW), ...
    'source_mjcf_sha256',C.source_mjcf_sha256,'mass_kg',mass,'gas_authored_stroke_m',gasStroke, ...
    'gas_400N_optimistic_work_upper_J',gasWork,'Mg270_J',mass*grav*.27, ...
    'fmincon_function_and_license_available',haveFmincon,'physical_teacher_valid',false, ...
    'original_PhysX_validated',false,'training_ingestion_allowed',false,'actuation_order',{{'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'}});
result.seed_pose_diagnostics=struct('extension',poseReport(gE),'tuck',poseReport(gT));
% The static tuck can hit guide rollers on the floor: do not assume it is a
% ground-safe crouch just because it is a closed-chain airborne pose.
writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'ENTRY_INPUT_GEOMETRY_AND_LICENSE_ACTUAL.json'),result);
if ~haveFmincon || ~opts.runOptimization
    result.status='FMINCON_UNAVAILABLE_OR_NOT_REQUESTED_SEED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY';
    writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'SEED_RESULT_ACTUAL.json'),result);return
end
op=optimoptions('fmincon','Display','off','Algorithm','sqp','MaxIterations',opts.maxIterations, ...
    'MaxFunctionEvaluations',4000,'ConstraintTolerance',1e-7,'OptimalityTolerance',1e-6);
% Project passive coordinates at a small set of commanded4-leg knots. Fixed
% rollers/wheel angles are seed coordinates; only the original6 controls are
% later eligible for actual simulation.
fixed=unique([act(:);wheel(:);find(startsWith(string(names),'guide_roller_'))]);
free=setdiff((1:30)',fixed);tau=linspace(0,1,9);Q=zeros(30,9);ik=cell(1,9);
for k=1:9
    a=sin(pi*tau(k))^2;target=(1-a)*qE+a*qT;
    [Q(:,k),ik{k}]=projectClosed(target,free,lb,ub,C,G,names,op);
end
result.passive_IK=ik;
% Variables [vx,vz,Tflight,takeoff_front,Taccel]. Neither2.4 nor the declared
% seed search upper bound4m/s is a physical vertical-speed limit.
x0=[1.2,2.6,.38,.10,.50];
xl=[.05,1.,.15,-.10,.15];xu=[C.wheel_motor.no_load_ground_speed_m_s,4.,.85,.14,1.5];
objective=@(x).5*mass*(x(1)^2+x(2)^2);
constraint=@(x)seedConstraints(x,C,G,names,Q,tau,opts,mass,grav);
[x,J,flag,output]=fmincon(objective,x0,[],[],[],[],xl,xu,constraint,op);
[c,ceq,rows]=seedConstraints(x,C,G,names,Q,tau,opts,mass,grav);
result.variables=struct('vx_m_s',x(1),'vz_m_s',x(2),'flight_s',x(3),'takeoff_front_m',x(4), ...
    'acceleration_s',x(5),'initial_design_front_m',opts.startFront,'mu_assumed_not_measured',opts.muAssumed);
result.optimization=struct('exitflag',flag,'output',output,'objective_COM_kinetic_J',J, ...
    'maximum_inequality_violation',max([0;c]),'maximum_equality_abs',max(abs(ceq)), ...
    'search_bound_vz4_is_not_physical_cap',true);
result.flight_seed_nodes=rows;result.joint_names=names;result.q30_reference_only=Q';
result.phase_plan=struct('accelerate_s',x(5),'crouch_and_push_s','NOT_YET_DYNAMICS_SOLVED', ...
    'air_tuck_extend_s',x(3),'minimum_top_contact_callbacks',12,'stable_physical_callbacks',200, ...
    'stable_seconds',.5,'original_2mm_per_environment_guard_unchanged',true);
result.optimistic_lower_bounds=struct('vertical_takeoff_kinetic_J',.5*mass*x(2)^2, ...
    'forward_takeoff_kinetic_J',.5*mass*x(1)^2,'vertical_impulse_N_s',mass*x(2), ...
    'additional_energy_before_losses_and_COM_raise_J',max(0,.5*mass*x(2)^2-gasWork));
% Targets are not inverse-dynamics torques. They do not include a feedforward
% PD torque demand, actual delay realization or compliant contact response.
processed=[Q(act,:)',repmat(x(1)/C.wheel_motor.wheel_radius_m,9,2)];
raw=[processed(:,1:4)/.5,processed(:,5:6)/10.];
result.processed_target6_seed_only=processed;result.raw_action6_seed_only=raw;
result.seed_action_map=struct('leg_default_q_rad',0,'leg_scale_rad',.5,'wheel_scale_rad_s',10, ...
    'raw_clip_original',6,'leg_PD_nominal',[60,2],'wheel_PD_nominal',[0,.6], ...
    'physical_target_delay_s',[0,.0025,.005],'CAD_difference_window',[-1.0843,.85], ...
    'source_order_differs_from_import_actuated_list',true,'actual_PD_torque_and_delay_NOT_verified',true);
result.remaining= {'Acceleration/crouch/push/landing actuation and angular momentum unsolved', ...
    'Motor torques/power/thermal/bus limits not established by no-load speed constraints', ...
    'Gas/COM/motor work bound is optimistic and ignores transmission and dissipation', ...
    'No full self collision, swept mesh contact, friction, impact or original PhysX qualification', ...
    'No state script playback: only a future validated action6 rollout may teach', ...
    'Actual initial reset/DR/PD/delay/preload parameters require ROOT binding'};
writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'SEED_RESULT_ACTUAL.json'),result);
save(fullfile(outDir,'KINEMATIC_REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_TEACHER.mat'),'result');
end

function [q,info]=projectClosed(seed,free,lb,ub,C,G,names,op)
q=seed; h=1e-6;g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);b=g.constraint_vector;
A=zeros(numel(b),numel(free));
for k=1:numel(free)
    qq=q;qq(free(k))=qq(free(k))+h;gg=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,qq);
    A(:,k)=(gg.constraint_vector-b)/h;
end
[~,RR,pivot]=qr(A','vector');tol=max(size(A))*eps(max(norm(A),1));r=sum(abs(diag(RR))>tol);
rows=pivot(1:r);make=@(y)replace(q,free,y);
fun=@(y)sum((y-seed(free)).^2);
nonlin=@(y)closedConstraints(make(y),C,G,names,rows);
[y,~,flag,output]=fmincon(fun,q(free),[],[],[],[],lb(free),ub(free),nonlin,op);
q=make(y);g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);
info=struct('exitflag',flag,'output',output,'selected_equation_rank',r, ...
    'closure_all_anchor_max_m',g.closure_max_m,'all_mimic_max_rad',max(abs(g.mimic_residual)), ...
    'report_all_redundant_equations_not_only_selected',true);
end
function [c,eq]=closedConstraints(q,C,G,names,rows)
g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);eq=g.constraint_vector(rows);
act=findNames(names,{'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip'});
d=q(act([1,3]))-q(act([2,4]));c=[-1.0843-d;d-.85];
end
function [c,eq,rows]=seedConstraints(x,C,G,names,Q,tau,opts,mass,grav)
vx=x(1);vz=x(2);T=x(3);front=x(4);ta=x(5);
first=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,Q(:,1));
p0=[front-max(first.wheel_high(1,:));0;-min(first.wheel_low(3,:))];COM0=first.COM+p0;
c=[];rows=cell(1,numel(tau));last=[];
for k=1:numel(tau)
    t=T*tau(k);rel=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,Q(:,k));
    COM=COM0+[vx*t;0;vz*t-.5*grav*t*t];root=COM-rel.COM;
    g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,Q(:,k),root);
    surface=zeros(1,size(g.shape_low,2));
    overlap=g.shape_high(1,:)>=.35 & g.shape_low(1,:)<=1.15 & ...
        g.shape_high(2,:)>=-.6 & g.shape_low(2,:)<=.6;
    surface(overlap)=.27;
    c=[c;(surface-g.shape_low(3,:))']; %#ok<AGROW> conservative authored-shape AABB condition
    if k>1 && k<numel(tau),c=[c;.005-g.wheel_low(3,:)'];end %#ok<AGROW>
    rows{k}=struct('t_s',t,'COM_reference_m',COM','root_reference_only_m',root', ...
        'wheel_low_m',g.wheel_low','wheel_high_m',g.wheel_high', ...
        'closure_max_m',g.closure_max_m,'mimic_max_rad',max(abs(g.mimic_residual)));
    last=g;
end
eq=[min(last.wheel_low(3,:))-.27;front-opts.startFront-.5*vx*ta];
c=[c;.35+.02-last.wheel_low(1,:)';last.wheel_high(1,:)'+vx^2/(2*opts.muAssumed*grav)-(1.15-.02)];
c=[c;-.6-last.wheel_low(2,:)';last.wheel_high(2,:)'- .6];
ax=vx/ta;omega=vx/C.wheel_motor.wheel_radius_m;
wheelCap=min(C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm,max(0,C.wheel_motor.envelope_intercept_nm-C.wheel_motor.envelope_slope_nm_s_rad*abs(omega)));
c=[c;ax-opts.muAssumed*grav;mass*ax*C.wheel_motor.wheel_radius_m/2-wheelCap];
act=findNames(names,{'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip'});
dq=diff(Q(act,:),1,2)./(T*diff(tau));
c=[c;abs(dq(:))-C.leg_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60];
end
function out=replace(q,ids,y),out=q;out(ids)=y;end
function ids=findNames(names,wanted),[ok,ids]=ismember(wanted,names);assert(all(ok));end
function r=poseReport(g)
root=[0;0;-min(g.wheel_low(3,:))];bn=g.body_names;
iswheel=ismember(g.shape_body_index,[find(strcmp(bn,'left_wheel')),find(strcmp(bn,'right_wheel'))]);
r=struct('root_floor_reference_z_m',root(3),'COM_floor_reference_z_m',g.COM(3)+root(3), ...
    'minimum_nonwheel_floor_clearance_m',min(g.shape_low(3,~iswheel))+root(3), ...
    'closure_all_anchor_max_m',g.closure_max_m,'mimic_max_rad',max(abs(g.mimic_residual)));
end
function [v,id]=readBound(path)
f=fopen(path,'rb');assert(f>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));bytes=fread(f,Inf,'*uint8');
md=javaMethod('getInstance','java.security.MessageDigest','SHA-256');md.update(typecast(bytes,'int8'));
hex=lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(),'uint8'),2)',1,[]));
id=struct('path',char(path),'bytes',numel(bytes),'sha256',hex,'reads',1);v=jsondecode(native2unicode(bytes','UTF-8'));
end
function writeJSON(path,value)
assert(~isfile(path),'Preserve original result');f=fopen(path,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);
cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(value,PrettyPrint=true));
end

function g = own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q,p,R)
% Own imported30-joint tree + authored shapes. Kinematics, not dynamics.
% No ideal linkage substitution; every passive/mimic/slide q is represented.
if nargin<5, p=zeros(3,1); end
if nargin<6, R=eye(3); end
names=cellstr(string(names)); bn=cellstr(string(G.body_names)); q=q(:);
assert(numel(q)==30 && numel(names)==30 && numel(bn)==31);
assert(strcmp(bn{1},'chassis'));
P=zeros(3,31); B=zeros(3,3,31); P(:,1)=p(:); B(:,:,1)=R;
jn=fieldnames(C.joints); bychild=containers.Map;
for j=1:numel(jn), bychild(C.joints.(jn{j}).child)=jn{j}; end
for b=2:31
    name=bychild(bn{b}); row=C.joints.(name); parent=find(strcmp(bn,row.parent),1);
    assert(parent<b,'Imported own body order must be topological');
    a=q(strcmp(names,name)); assert(isscalar(a));
    A=B(:,:,parent)*qmat(row.local_rot0); axis=A(:,1);
    if strcmp(row.type,'hinge')
        motion=[1 0 0;0 cos(a) -sin(a);0 sin(a) cos(a)];
        B(:,:,b)=A*motion*qmat(row.local_rot1)';
        P(:,b)=P(:,parent)+B(:,:,parent)*row.local_pos0(:)-B(:,:,b)*row.local_pos1(:);
    elseif strcmp(row.type,'slide')
        B(:,:,b)=A*qmat(row.local_rot1)';
        P(:,b)=P(:,parent)+B(:,:,parent)*row.local_pos0(:)+axis*a-B(:,:,b)*row.local_pos1(:);
    else
        error('Only exact imported hinge/slide joints admitted');
    end
end
shapes=G.shapes; if isstruct(shapes), shapes=num2cell(shapes); end
lo=zeros(3,numel(shapes)); hi=lo; body=zeros(1,numel(shapes));
for s=1:numel(shapes)
    h=shapes{s}; b=find(strcmp(bn,h.body),1); body(s)=b;
    A=B(:,:,b)*h.linear_body_from_shape;
    centre=P(:,b)+B(:,:,b)*h.origin_body_m(:);
    switch h.type
        case 'Mesh'
            points=A*h.points'+centre;
            lo(:,s)=min(points,[],2); hi(:,s)=max(points,[],2);
        case 'Cube'
            radius=sum(abs(A),2)*h.size/2;
            lo(:,s)=centre-radius; hi(:,s)=centre+radius;
        case {'Cylinder','Capsule'}
            axis=double(h.axis)+1; radial=setdiff(1:3,axis);
            segment=abs(A(:,axis))*h.height/2;
            if strcmp(h.type,'Cylinder')
                radius=segment+h.radius*sqrt(sum(A(:,radial).^2,2));
            else
                radius=segment+h.radius*sqrt(sum(A.^2,2));
            end
            lo(:,s)=centre-radius; hi(:,s)=centre+radius;
        otherwise
            error('Unqualified authored shape kind');
    end
end
wl=zeros(3,2); wh=wl; wheelNames={'left_wheel','right_wheel'};
for k=1:2
    mask=body==find(strcmp(bn,wheelNames{k}),1);
    wl(:,k)=min(lo(:,mask),[],2); wh(:,k)=max(hi(:,mask),[],2);
end
mass=zeros(31,1); com=zeros(3,31);
for b=1:31
    row=C.bodies.(bn{b}); mass(b)=row.mass_kg;
    com(:,b)=P(:,b)+B(:,:,b)*row.com_m(:);
end
cn=fieldnames(C.closures); phi=zeros(3,numel(cn));
for i=1:numel(cn)
    c=C.closures.(cn{i}); a=find(strcmp(bn,c.body0),1); b=find(strcmp(bn,c.body1),1);
    phi(:,i)=P(:,a)+B(:,:,a)*c.anchor0_m(:)-P(:,b)-B(:,:,b)*c.anchor1_m(:);
end
mn=fieldnames(C.mimics); mimic=zeros(numel(mn),1);
for i=1:numel(mn)
    row=C.mimics.(mn{i}); j=find(strcmp(names,mn{i})); k=find(strcmp(names,row.reference_joint));
    % PhysX-style q_joint + gearing*q_reference + offset = 0 convention.
    % ROOT must confirm the exact MJCF/backend convention before dynamics use.
    mimic(i)=q(j)+row.gearing*q(k)+row.offset;
end
g=struct('body_names',{bn},'body_position',P,'body_rotation',B,'shape_low',lo,'shape_high',hi, ...
    'shape_body_index',body,'wheel_low',wl,'wheel_high',wh,'mass_kg',sum(mass), ...
    'body_COM',com,'COM',com*mass/sum(mass),'closure_residual',phi, ...
    'closure_max_m',max(sqrt(sum(phi.^2,1))),'mimic_residual',mimic, ...
    'constraint_vector',[phi(:);mimic(:)]);
end

function R=qmat(q)
q=q(:)/norm(q); w=q(1);x=q(2);y=q(3);z=q(4);
R=[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y); ...
   2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x); ...
   2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)];
end
