function result=solve_mod4_teacher_seed_v1(contractPath,geometryPath,witnessPath,outDir,opts)
% Executable own-geometry/COM/energy + constrained flight SEED. NOT a teacher.
% ROOT invokes this in the existing MATLAB session. No app/SDK/model startup.
% Root/pose rows are REFERENCES ONLY: never play by writing simulated states.
if nargin<5, opts=struct; end
if ~isfield(opts,'startFront'),opts.startFront=-.20;end % design runway, not an actual reset
if ~isfield(opts,'muAssumed'),opts.muAssumed=.7;end     % engineering nominal mix; not measured
if ~isfield(opts,'runOptimization'),opts.runOptimization=true;end
if ~isfield(opts,'maxIterations'),opts.maxIterations=60;end
assert(~isfolder(outDir),'Use an exclusive NEW purpose output directory');mkdir(outDir);
[C,idC]=readBound(contractPath);[G,idG]=readBound(geometryPath);[W,idW]=readBound(witnessPath);
assert(strcmp(C.source_mjcf_sha256,'fbb0393883d31ac96f8cd58a184585470222f7daf96af6aa5d0748a1752c366c'));
names=cellstr(string(W.joint_names)); qE=W.extension.row.joint_pos30(:);qT=W.tuck.row.joint_pos30(:);
gE=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,qE);gT=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,qT);
mass=gE.mass_kg;grav=9.81;actNames={'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip'};
act=findNames(names,actNames);wheel=findNames(names,{'left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'});
lb=-inf(30,1);ub=inf(30,1);
for j=1:30
    limits=C.joints.(names{j}).limits_si;
    if ~isempty(limits),lb(j)=limits(1);ub(j)=limits(2);end
end
gasNames=fieldnames(C.gas_springs);gasWork=0;gasStroke=zeros(2,1);
for j=1:2
    a=C.joints.(gasNames{j}).limits_si;gasStroke(j)=a(2)-a(1);
    assert(gasStroke(j)<=.060000001);gasWork=gasWork+400*gasStroke(j);
end
haveFmincon=exist('fmincon','file')==2 && license('test','Optimization_Toolbox');
result=struct('schema','mod4.own.teacher_matlab_seed.v1','status','KINEMATIC_SEED_ONLY_NOT_DYNAMICS_VALIDATED', ...
    'input_identity',struct('contract',idC,'geometry',idG,'witness',idW), ...
    'source_mjcf_sha256',C.source_mjcf_sha256,'mass_kg',mass,'gas_authored_stroke_m',gasStroke, ...
    'gas_400N_optimistic_work_upper_J',gasWork,'Mg270_J',mass*grav*.27, ...
    'fmincon_function_and_license_available',haveFmincon,'physical_teacher_valid',false, ...
    'original_PhysX_validated',false,'training_ingestion_allowed',false,'actuation_order',{{'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip','left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin'}});
result.seed_pose_diagnostics=struct('extension',poseReport(gE),'tuck',poseReport(gT));
% The static tuck can hit guide rollers on the floor: do not assume it is a
% ground-safe crouch just because it is a closed-chain airborne pose.
writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'ENTRY_INPUT_GEOMETRY_AND_LICENSE_ACTUAL.json'),result);
if ~haveFmincon || ~opts.runOptimization
    result.status='FMINCON_UNAVAILABLE_OR_NOT_REQUESTED_SEED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY';
    writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'SEED_RESULT_ACTUAL.json'),result);return
end
op=optimoptions('fmincon','Display','off','Algorithm','sqp','MaxIterations',opts.maxIterations, ...
    'MaxFunctionEvaluations',4000,'ConstraintTolerance',1e-7,'OptimalityTolerance',1e-6);
% Project passive coordinates at a small set of commanded4-leg knots. Fixed
% rollers/wheel angles are seed coordinates; only the original6 controls are
% later eligible for actual simulation.
fixed=unique([act(:);wheel(:);find(startsWith(string(names),'guide_roller_'))]);
free=setdiff((1:30)',fixed);tau=linspace(0,1,9);Q=zeros(30,9);ik=cell(1,9);
for k=1:9
    a=sin(pi*tau(k))^2;target=(1-a)*qE+a*qT;
    [Q(:,k),ik{k}]=projectClosed(target,free,lb,ub,C,G,names,op);
end
result.passive_IK=ik;
% Variables [vx,vz,Tflight,takeoff_front,Taccel]. Neither2.4 nor the declared
% seed search upper bound4m/s is a physical vertical-speed limit.
x0=[1.2,2.6,.38,.10,.50];
xl=[.05,1.,.15,-.10,.15];xu=[C.wheel_motor.no_load_ground_speed_m_s,4.,.85,.14,1.5];
objective=@(x).5*mass*(x(1)^2+x(2)^2);
constraint=@(x)seedConstraints(x,C,G,names,Q,tau,opts,mass,grav);
[x,J,flag,output]=fmincon(objective,x0,[],[],[],[],xl,xu,constraint,op);
[c,ceq,rows]=seedConstraints(x,C,G,names,Q,tau,opts,mass,grav);
result.variables=struct('vx_m_s',x(1),'vz_m_s',x(2),'flight_s',x(3),'takeoff_front_m',x(4), ...
    'acceleration_s',x(5),'initial_design_front_m',opts.startFront,'mu_assumed_not_measured',opts.muAssumed);
result.optimization=struct('exitflag',flag,'output',output,'objective_COM_kinetic_J',J, ...
    'maximum_inequality_violation',max([0;c]),'maximum_equality_abs',max(abs(ceq)), ...
    'search_bound_vz4_is_not_physical_cap',true);
result.flight_seed_nodes=rows;result.joint_names=names;result.q30_reference_only=Q';
result.phase_plan=struct('accelerate_s',x(5),'crouch_and_push_s','NOT_YET_DYNAMICS_SOLVED', ...
    'air_tuck_extend_s',x(3),'minimum_top_contact_callbacks',12,'stable_physical_callbacks',200, ...
    'stable_seconds',.5,'original_2mm_per_environment_guard_unchanged',true);
result.optimistic_lower_bounds=struct('vertical_takeoff_kinetic_J',.5*mass*x(2)^2, ...
    'forward_takeoff_kinetic_J',.5*mass*x(1)^2,'vertical_impulse_N_s',mass*x(2), ...
    'additional_energy_before_losses_and_COM_raise_J',max(0,.5*mass*x(2)^2-gasWork));
% Targets are not inverse-dynamics torques. They do not include a feedforward
% PD torque demand, actual delay realization or compliant contact response.
processed=[Q(act,:)',repmat(x(1)/C.wheel_motor.wheel_radius_m,9,2)];
raw=[processed(:,1:4)/.5,processed(:,5:6)/10.];
result.processed_target6_seed_only=processed;result.raw_action6_seed_only=raw;
result.seed_action_map=struct('leg_default_q_rad',0,'leg_scale_rad',.5,'wheel_scale_rad_s',10, ...
    'raw_clip_original',6,'leg_PD_nominal',[60,2],'wheel_PD_nominal',[0,.6], ...
    'physical_target_delay_s',[0,.0025,.005],'CAD_difference_window',[-1.0843,.85], ...
    'source_order_differs_from_import_actuated_list',true,'actual_PD_torque_and_delay_NOT_verified',true);
result.remaining= {'Acceleration/crouch/push/landing actuation and angular momentum unsolved', ...
    'Motor torques/power/thermal/bus limits not established by no-load speed constraints', ...
    'Gas/COM/motor work bound is optimistic and ignores transmission and dissipation', ...
    'No full self collision, swept mesh contact, friction, impact or original PhysX qualification', ...
    'No state script playback: only a future validated action6 rollout may teach', ...
    'Actual initial reset/DR/PD/delay/preload parameters require ROOT binding'};
writeJSON(fullfile(outDir,'SEED_RESULT_ACTUAL.json'),result);
save(fullfile(outDir,'KINEMATIC_REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_TEACHER.mat'),'result');
end

function [q,info]=projectClosed(seed,free,lb,ub,C,G,names,op)
q=seed; h=1e-6;g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);b=g.constraint_vector;
A=zeros(numel(b),numel(free));
for k=1:numel(free)
    qq=q;qq(free(k))=qq(free(k))+h;gg=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,qq);
    A(:,k)=(gg.constraint_vector-b)/h;
end
[~,RR,pivot]=qr(A','vector');tol=max(size(A))*eps(max(norm(A),1));r=sum(abs(diag(RR))>tol);
rows=pivot(1:r);make=@(y)replace(q,free,y);
fun=@(y)sum((y-seed(free)).^2);
nonlin=@(y)closedConstraints(make(y),C,G,names,rows);
[y,~,flag,output]=fmincon(fun,q(free),[],[],[],[],lb(free),ub(free),nonlin,op);
q=make(y);g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);
info=struct('exitflag',flag,'output',output,'selected_equation_rank',r, ...
    'closure_all_anchor_max_m',g.closure_max_m,'all_mimic_max_rad',max(abs(g.mimic_residual)), ...
    'report_all_redundant_equations_not_only_selected',true);
end
function [c,eq]=closedConstraints(q,C,G,names,rows)
g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);eq=g.constraint_vector(rows);
act=findNames(names,{'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip'});
d=q(act([1,3]))-q(act([2,4]));c=[-1.0843-d;d-.85];
end
function [c,eq,rows]=seedConstraints(x,C,G,names,Q,tau,opts,mass,grav)
vx=x(1);vz=x(2);T=x(3);front=x(4);ta=x(5);
first=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,Q(:,1));
p0=[front-max(first.wheel_high(1,:));0;-min(first.wheel_low(3,:))];COM0=first.COM+p0;
c=[];rows=cell(1,numel(tau));last=[];
for k=1:numel(tau)
    t=T*tau(k);rel=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,Q(:,k));
    COM=COM0+[vx*t;0;vz*t-.5*grav*t*t];root=COM-rel.COM;
    g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,Q(:,k),root);
    surface=zeros(1,size(g.shape_low,2));
    overlap=g.shape_high(1,:)>=.35 & g.shape_low(1,:)<=1.15 & ...
        g.shape_high(2,:)>=-.6 & g.shape_low(2,:)<=.6;
    surface(overlap)=.27;
    c=[c;(surface-g.shape_low(3,:))']; %#ok<AGROW> conservative authored-shape AABB condition
    if k>1 && k<numel(tau),c=[c;.005-g.wheel_low(3,:)'];end %#ok<AGROW>
    rows{k}=struct('t_s',t,'COM_reference_m',COM','root_reference_only_m',root', ...
        'wheel_low_m',g.wheel_low','wheel_high_m',g.wheel_high', ...
        'closure_max_m',g.closure_max_m,'mimic_max_rad',max(abs(g.mimic_residual)));
    last=g;
end
eq=[min(last.wheel_low(3,:))-.27;front-opts.startFront-.5*vx*ta];
c=[c;.35+.02-last.wheel_low(1,:)';last.wheel_high(1,:)'+vx^2/(2*opts.muAssumed*grav)-(1.15-.02)];
c=[c;-.6-last.wheel_low(2,:)';last.wheel_high(2,:)'- .6];
ax=vx/ta;omega=vx/C.wheel_motor.wheel_radius_m;
wheelCap=min(C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm,max(0,C.wheel_motor.envelope_intercept_nm-C.wheel_motor.envelope_slope_nm_s_rad*abs(omega)));
c=[c;ax-opts.muAssumed*grav;mass*ax*C.wheel_motor.wheel_radius_m/2-wheelCap];
act=findNames(names,{'left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip'});
dq=diff(Q(act,:),1,2)./(T*diff(tau));
c=[c;abs(dq(:))-C.leg_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*2*pi/60];
end
function out=replace(q,ids,y),out=q;out(ids)=y;end
function ids=findNames(names,wanted),[ok,ids]=ismember(wanted,names);assert(all(ok));end
function r=poseReport(g)
root=[0;0;-min(g.wheel_low(3,:))];bn=g.body_names;
iswheel=ismember(g.shape_body_index,[find(strcmp(bn,'left_wheel')),find(strcmp(bn,'right_wheel'))]);
r=struct('root_floor_reference_z_m',root(3),'COM_floor_reference_z_m',g.COM(3)+root(3), ...
    'minimum_nonwheel_floor_clearance_m',min(g.shape_low(3,~iswheel))+root(3), ...
    'closure_all_anchor_max_m',g.closure_max_m,'mimic_max_rad',max(abs(g.mimic_residual)));
end
function [v,id]=readBound(path)
f=fopen(path,'rb');assert(f>=0);cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));bytes=fread(f,Inf,'*uint8');
md=javaMethod('getInstance','java.security.MessageDigest','SHA-256');md.update(typecast(bytes,'int8'));
hex=lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(),'uint8'),2)',1,[]));
id=struct('path',char(path),'bytes',numel(bytes),'sha256',hex,'reads',1);v=jsondecode(native2unicode(bytes','UTF-8'));
end
function writeJSON(path,value)
assert(~isfile(path),'Preserve original result');f=fopen(path,'w','n','UTF-8');assert(f>=0);
cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));fprintf(f,'%s\n',jsonencode(value,PrettyPrint=true));
end

"""Type/MRO/code-origin metadata for ALREADY created objects, never creates SDK.

No file IO/import of SDK/Torch/inspect, instance getter, method invocation,
registry or SimulationContext query. Passing objects is not construction or
execution authorization. A future caller must supply its original objects.

import types

METHODS={'robot':('_apply_actuator_model','write_data_to_sim'),
         'legs':('compute','_clip_effort'),'wheels':('compute','_clip_effort')}
FIELDS={'robot':('_joint_effort_target_sim',),
        'legs':('stiffness','damping','effort_limit','velocity_limit','_saturation_effort',
                '_vel_at_effort_lim','_joint_vel','episode_scale','step_scale')}
FIELDS['wheels']=FIELDS['legs']


def class_label(cls):
    # Bypass user/metaclass attribute hooks; metadata from intrinsic type slots.
    return dict(module=type.__getattribute__(cls,'__module__'),
                qualname=type.__getattribute__(cls,'__qualname__'))


def method_owner(cls,name):
    chain=type.__getattribute__(cls,'__mro__')
    for owner in chain:
        slots=type.__getattribute__(owner,'__dict__')
        if name not in slots:continue
        value=slots[name];kind=type(value).__name__
        if type(value) in (classmethod,staticmethod):
            fn=value.__func__;ordinary=False
        elif type(value) is types.FunctionType:
            fn=value;ordinary=True
        else:
            return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_UNSUPPORTED_DESCRIPTOR_OR_NATIVE',
                        owner=class_label(owner),descriptor_kind=kind,
                        no_descriptor_bound_or_called=True)
        if type(fn) is not types.FunctionType:
            return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_NON_PYTHON_FUNCTION',owner=class_label(owner),descriptor_kind=kind)
        code=fn.__code__;abstract=fn.__dict__.get('__isabstractmethod__',False)
        if type(abstract)is not bool:
            return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_NONBOOL_ABSTRACT_FLAG',owner=class_label(owner))
        result=dict(method=name,status='EXISTING_PYTHON_FUNCTION_OWNER_OBSERVED',
            owner=class_label(owner),descriptor_kind=kind,
            is_ordinary_instance_function=ordinary,is_abstract=abstract,
            code_filename=code.co_filename,code_firstlineno=code.co_firstlineno,
            code_name=code.co_name,arguments=list(code.co_varnames[:code.co_argcount+code.co_kwonlyargcount]),
            positional_only_count=code.co_posonlyargcount,defaults_count=len(fn.__defaults__or()),
            has_varargs=bool(code.co_flags&4),has_varkw=bool(code.co_flags&8),
            no_method_or_descriptor_call=True,source_bytes_AST_not_read_or_bound=True)
        result['candidate_for_later_exact_source_pin']=ordinary and not abstract
        return result
    return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_METHOD_ABSENT_FROM_ACTUAL_MRO')


def plain_field_types(obj,names):
    cls=type(obj)
    descriptor=None
    for owner in type.__getattribute__(cls,'__mro__'):
        slots=type.__getattribute__(owner,'__dict__')
        if '__dict__'in slots:
            descriptor=slots['__dict__'];break
    if type(descriptor)is not types.GetSetDescriptorType:
        return dict(status='UNKNOWN_NO_STANDARD_INSTANCE_DICT',field_values_not_accessed=True)
    values=descriptor.__get__(obj,cls)
    return dict(status='EXISTING_PLAIN_INSTANCE_DICT_FIELD_TYPES_ONLY',fields={n:
        dict(present=n in values,type=class_label(type(values[n]))if n in values else None)
        for n in names},shape_device_tensor_contents_properties_not_read=True)


def record_existing_instances(robot,legs,wheels,*,already_retained_manager_name=None,
                              manager_name_origin='UNKNOWN'):
    objects=dict(robot=robot,legs=legs,wheels=wheels);rows={}
    for name,obj in objects.items():
        cls=type(obj)
        rows[name]=dict(concrete_type=class_label(cls),
            actual_MRO=[class_label(c)for c in type.__getattribute__(cls,'__mro__')],
            methods=[method_owner(cls,m)for m in METHODS[name]],
            plain_field_types=plain_field_types(obj,FIELDS[name]))

"""Type/MRO/code-origin metadata for ALREADY created objects, never creates SDK.

No file IO/import of SDK/Torch/inspect, instance getter, method invocation,
registry or SimulationContext query. Passing objects is not construction or
execution authorization. A future caller must supply its original objects.

import types

METHODS={'robot':('_apply_actuator_model','write_data_to_sim'),
         'legs':('compute','_clip_effort'),'wheels':('compute','_clip_effort')}
FIELDS={'robot':('_joint_effort_target_sim',),
        'legs':('stiffness','damping','effort_limit','velocity_limit','_saturation_effort',
                '_vel_at_effort_lim','_joint_vel','episode_scale','step_scale')}
FIELDS['wheels']=FIELDS['legs']


def class_label(cls):
    # Bypass user/metaclass attribute hooks; metadata from intrinsic type slots.
    return dict(module=type.__getattribute__(cls,'__module__'),
                qualname=type.__getattribute__(cls,'__qualname__'))


def method_owner(cls,name):
    chain=type.__getattribute__(cls,'__mro__')
    for owner in chain:
        slots=type.__getattribute__(owner,'__dict__')
        if name not in slots:continue
        value=slots[name];kind=type(value).__name__
        if type(value) in (classmethod,staticmethod):
            fn=value.__func__;ordinary=False
        elif type(value) is types.FunctionType:
            fn=value;ordinary=True
        else:
            return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_UNSUPPORTED_DESCRIPTOR_OR_NATIVE',
                        owner=class_label(owner),descriptor_kind=kind,
                        no_descriptor_bound_or_called=True)
        if type(fn) is not types.FunctionType:
            return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_NON_PYTHON_FUNCTION',owner=class_label(owner),descriptor_kind=kind)
        code=fn.__code__;abstract=fn.__dict__.get('__isabstractmethod__',False)
        if type(abstract)is not bool:
            return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_NONBOOL_ABSTRACT_FLAG',owner=class_label(owner))
        result=dict(method=name,status='EXISTING_PYTHON_FUNCTION_OWNER_OBSERVED',
            owner=class_label(owner),descriptor_kind=kind,
            is_ordinary_instance_function=ordinary,is_abstract=abstract,
            code_filename=code.co_filename,code_firstlineno=code.co_firstlineno,
            code_name=code.co_name,arguments=list(code.co_varnames[:code.co_argcount+code.co_kwonlyargcount]),
            positional_only_count=code.co_posonlyargcount,defaults_count=len(fn.__defaults__ or ()),
            has_varargs=bool(code.co_flags&4),has_varkw=bool(code.co_flags&8),
            no_method_or_descriptor_call=True,source_bytes_AST_not_read_or_bound=True)
        result['candidate_for_later_exact_source_pin']=ordinary and not abstract
        return result
    return dict(method=name,status='UNKNOWN_METHOD_ABSENT_FROM_ACTUAL_MRO')


def plain_field_types(obj,names):
    cls=type(obj)
    descriptor=None
    for owner in type.__getattribute__(cls,'__mro__'):
        slots=type.__getattribute__(owner,'__dict__')
        if '__dict__'in slots:
            descriptor=slots['__dict__'];break
    if type(descriptor)is not types.GetSetDescriptorType:
        return dict(status='UNKNOWN_NO_STANDARD_INSTANCE_DICT',field_values_not_accessed=True)
    values=descriptor.__get__(obj,cls)
    return dict(status='EXISTING_PLAIN_INSTANCE_DICT_FIELD_TYPES_ONLY',fields={n:
        dict(present=n in values,type=class_label(type(values[n]))if n in values else None)
        for n in names},shape_device_tensor_contents_properties_not_read=True)


def record_existing_instances(robot,legs,wheels,*,already_retained_manager_name=None,
                              manager_name_origin='UNKNOWN'):
    objects=dict(robot=robot,legs=legs,wheels=wheels);rows={}
    for name,obj in objects.items():
        cls=type(obj)
        rows[name]=dict(concrete_type=class_label(cls),
            actual_MRO=[class_label(c)for c in type.__getattribute__(cls,'__mro__')],
            methods=[method_owner(cls,m)for m in METHODS[name]],
            plain_field_types=plain_field_types(obj,FIELDS[name]))
    qualified=all(m.get('candidate_for_later_exact_source_pin',False)
                  for row in rows.values()for m in row['methods'])
    return dict(status='EXISTING_INSTANCE_OWNER_METADATA_ONLY',objects=rows,
        already_retained_manager_name=already_retained_manager_name,
        manager_name_origin=manager_name_origin,
        manager_context_not_queried=True,declared_registry_not_called_or_assumed=True,
        ordinary_nonabstract_owner_names_available=qualified,
        actual_source_bytes_AST_semantics_and_compute_apply_timing_passed=False,
        runtime_hook_installable=False,actual_GPU_fullstate_or_skill_ready=False,

"""Pure manifest, read-once and returned metadata validation; no SDK import."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

MAX_FILE_BYTES=1024**2
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES=3*MAX_FILE_BYTES

def H(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def read_exact_source_once(path, row, counts):
    """One open, two forward reads including explicit EOF. No reopen/hash pass."""
    path=Path(path)
    before=path.stat()
    assert path.resolve()==path and not path.is_symlink()
    assert path.suffix=='.py' and 0<before.st_size<=MAX_FILE_BYTES
    assert counts['content_opens']==counts['read_calls']==counts['logical_passes']==0
    counts['content_opens']+=1;counts['logical_passes']+=1
    with path.open('rb')as f:
        counts['read_calls']+=1;raw=f.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES+1)
        counts['read_calls']+=1;eof=f.read(1)
    counts['bytes_read']=len(raw)+len(eof);counts['explicit_EOF_observed']=eof==b''
    after=path.stat()
    assert (before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==(after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns)
    assert eof==b'' and len(raw)==before.st_size and len(raw)<=MAX_FILE_BYTES
    if row.get('known_bytes')is not None:assert len(raw)==row['known_bytes']
    digest=H(raw)
    if row.get('known_SHA')is not None:assert digest==row['known_SHA']
    text=raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
    # Original UTF8 is returned separately byte-exact, including any BOM.
    return raw,dict(path=str(path),bytes=len(raw),SHA=digest,UTF8=raw.decode('utf-8'),
        before_mtime_ns=before.st_mtime_ns,after_mtime_ns=after.st_mtime_ns,
        actual_source_read_counts=dict(counts),scope='Python source only, not model/raw',
        parser_text_has_optional_BOM_removed=text!=raw.decode('utf-8'))

def validate_returned_attempt(value,purpose):
    assert value['purpose_id']==purpose['purpose_id']
    assert value['metadata_only']is True and value['GPU_ready']is False
    assert value['runtime_case_ready']is False and value['actual_SDK_semantic_timing_gates_passed']is False
    rows=value['complete_original_source_UTF8']
    if value['passed_source_inventory_capture']:
        assert len(rows)==3
    declared={r['key']:r for r in purpose['source_files']};seen=set();total=0
    for r in rows:
        raw=r['UTF8'].encode('utf-8');assert r['key']not in seen;seen.add(r['key'])
        expect=declared[r['key']];assert r['path']==expect['path']
        assert len(raw)==r['bytes']and H(raw)==r['SHA'];total+=len(raw)
        if expect.get('known_SHA')is not None:assert H(raw)==expect['known_SHA']
        count=r['actual_source_read_counts']
        assert count['content_opens']==count['logical_passes']==1 and count['read_calls']==2
        assert count['explicit_EOF_observed']and count['bytes_read']==len(raw)
    assert total<=MAX_TOTAL_BYTES
    inventory=value.get('declaration_inventory')
    if value['passed_source_inventory_capture']:
        assert inventory is not None and inventory['actual_runtime_API_passed']is False
        assert inventory['diagnostic_runtime_installable']is False
        for r in rows:
            actual=inventory['inventory'][r['key']]
            assert (actual['path'],actual['bytes'],actual['SHA'])==(r['path'],r['bytes'],r['SHA'])
    assert value['source_content_read_plan']['reopen_or_seek_allowed']is False
    return dict(passed_transport_and_full_original_source_integrity=True,source_files=len(rows),bytes=total,
                declarations_resolved=value.get('declarations_resolved_all',False),
                actual_runtime_API_or_GPU_qualification=False)

            actual_source_read_counts=reads,complete_original_source_UTF8=sources,
            declaration_inventory=inventory,original_error=error,new_own_namespace_created=created,
            source_payload_publications=payload_publications,
            complete_original_metadata_UTF8=texts,
            no_supervisor_worker_GPU_Task_or_private_lock_constructed=True,
            no_old_V11_task_once_source_or_model_modified=True)
        if created:
            try:
                publication=put('METADATA_ONLY_ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_TERMINAL_ACTUAL.json',result)
            except BaseException:
                result['metadata_terminal_publication_original_error']=traceback.format_exc()
        result['terminal_producer']=publication
    return result

In most cases,\n    the motor is connected to a constant source of voltage supply, and the current is controlled by a rheostat.\n    Depending on various design factors such as windings and materials, the motor can draw a limited maximum power\n    from the electronic source, which limits the produced motor torque and speed.\n\n    A DC motor characteristics are defined by the following parameters:\n\n    * No-load speed (:math:`\\dot{q}_{motor, max}`) : The maximum-rated speed of the motor at\n      zero torque (:attr:`velocity_limit`).\n    * Stall torque (:math:`\\tau_{motor, stall}`): The maximum-rated torque produced at\n      zero speed (:attr:`saturation_effort`).\n    * Continuous torque (:math:`\\tau_{motor, con}`): The maximum torque that can be outputted for a short period.\n      This is often enforced on the current drives for a DC motor to limit overheating, prevent mechanical damage,\n      or enforced by electrical limitations (:attr:`effort_limit`).\n    * Corner velocity (:math:`V_{c}`): The velocity where the torque-speed curve intersects with continuous torque.\n\n    Based on these parameters, the instantaneous minimum and maximum torques for velocities between corner velocities\n    (where torque-speed curve intersects with continuous torque) are defined as follows:\n\n    .. math::\n\n        \\tau_{j, max}(\\dot{q}) & = clip \\left (\\tau_{j, stall} \\times \\left(1 -\n            \\frac{\\dot{q}}{\\dot{q}_{j, max}}\\right), -\u221e, \\tau_{j, con} \\right) \\\\\n        \\tau_{j, min}(\\dot{q}) & = clip \\left (\\tau_{j, stall} \\times \\left( -1 -\n            \\frac{\\dot{q}}{\\dot{q}_{j, max}}\\right), - \\tau_{j, con}, \u221e \\right)\n\n    where :math:`\\gamma` is the gear ratio of the gear box connecting the motor and the actuated joint ends,\n    :math:`\\dot{q}_{j, max} = \\gamma^{-1} \\times  \\dot{q}_{motor, max}`, :math:`\\tau_{j, con} =\n    \\gamma \\times \\tau_{motor, con}` and :math:`\\tau_{j, stall} = \\gamma \\times \\tau_{motor, stall}`\n    are the maximum joint velocity, continuous joint torque and stall torque, respectively. These parameters\n    are read from the configuration instance passed to the class.\n\n    Using these values, the computed torques are clipped to the minimum and maximum values based on the\n    instantaneous joint velocity:\n\n    .. math::\n\n        \\tau_{j, applied} = clip(\\tau_{computed}, \\tau_{j, min}(\\dot{q}), \\tau_{j, max}(\\dot{q}))\n\n    If the velocity of the joint is outside corner velocities (this would be due to external forces) the\n    applied output torque will be driven to the Continuous Torque (`effort_limit`).\n\n    The figure below demonstrates the clipping action for example (velocity, torque) pairs.\n\n    .. figure:: ../../_static/actuator-group/dc_motor_clipping.jpg\n        :align: center\n        :figwidth: 100%\n        :alt: The effort clipping as a function of joint velocity for a linear DC Motor.\n\n    \"\"\"\n\n    cfg: DCMotorCfg\n    \"\"\"The configuration for the actuator model.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, cfg: DCMotorCfg, *args, **kwargs):\n        super().__init__(cfg, *args, **kwargs)\n        # parse configuration\n        if self.cfg.saturation_effort is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"The saturation_effort must be provided for the DC motor actuator model.\")\n        self._saturation_effort = self.cfg.saturation_effort\n        # find the velocity on the torque-speed curve that intersects effort_limit in the second and fourth quadrant\n        self._vel_at_effort_lim = self.velocity_limit * (1 + self.effort_limit / self._saturation_effort)\n        # prepare joint vel buffer for max effort computation\n        self._joint_vel = torch.zeros_like(self.computed_effort)\n        # create buffer for zeros effort\n        self._zeros_effort = torch.zeros_like(self.computed_effort)\n        # check that quantities are provided\n        if self.cfg.velocity_limit is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"The velocity limit must be provided for the DC motor actuator model.\")\n\n    \"\"\"\n    Operations.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def compute(\n        self, control_action: ArticulationActions, joint_pos: torch.Tensor, joint_vel: torch.Tensor\n    ) -> ArticulationActions:\n        # save current joint vel\n        self._joint_vel[:] = joint_vel\n        # calculate the desired joint torques\n        return super().compute(control_action, joint_pos, joint_vel)\n\n    \"\"\"\n    Helper functions.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def _clip_effort(self, effort: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\n        # save current joint vel\n        self._joint_vel[:] = torch.clip(self._joint_vel, min=-self._vel_at_effort_lim, max=self._vel_at_effort_lim)\n        # compute torque limits\n        torque_speed_top = self._saturation_effort * (1.0 - self._joint_vel / self.velocity_limit)\n        torque_speed_bottom = self._saturation_effort * (-1.0 - self._joint_vel / self.velocity_limit)\n        # -- max limit\n        max_effort = torch.clip(torque_speed_top, max=self.effort_limit)\n        # -- min limit\n        min_effort = torch.clip(torque_speed_bottom, min=-self.effort_limit)\n        # clip the torques based on the motor limits\n        clamped = torch.clip(effort, min=min_effort, max=max_effort)\n        return clamped\n\n\nclass DelayedPDActuator(IdealPDActuator):\n    \"\"\"Ideal PD actuator with delayed command application.\n\n    This class extends the :class:`IdealPDActuator` class by adding a delay to the actuator commands. The delay\n    is implemented using a circular buffer that stores the actuator commands for a certain number of physics steps.\n    The most recent actuation value is pushed to the buffer at every physics step, but the final actuation value\n    applied to the simulation is lagged by a certain number of physics steps.\n\n    The amount of time lag is configurable and can be set to a random value between the minimum and maximum time\n    lag bounds at every reset. The minimum and maximum time lag values are set in the configuration instance passed\n    to the class.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    cfg: DelayedPDActuatorCfg\n    \"\"\"The configuration for the actuator model.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, cfg: DelayedPDActuatorCfg, *args, **kwargs):\n        super().__init__(cfg, *args, **kwargs)\n        # instantiate the delay buffers\n        self.positions_delay_buffer = DelayBuffer(cfg.max_delay, self._num_envs, device=self._device)\n        self.velocities_delay_buffer = DelayBuffer(cfg.max_delay, self._num_envs, device=self._device)\n        self.efforts_delay_buffer = DelayBuffer(cfg.max_delay, self._num_envs, device=self._device)\n        # all of the envs\n        self._ALL_INDICES = torch.arange(self._num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=self._device)\n\n    def reset(self, env_ids: Sequence[int]):\n        super().reset(env_ids)\n        # number of environments (since env_ids can be a slice)\n        if env_ids is None or env_ids == slice(None):\n            num_envs = self._num_envs\n        else:\n            num_envs = len(env_ids)\n        # set a new random delay for environments in env_ids\n        time_lags = torch.randint(\n            low=self.cfg.min_delay,\n            high=self.cfg.max_delay + 1,\n            size=(num_envs,),\n            dtype=torch.int,\n            device=self._device,\n        )\n        # set delays\n        self.positions_delay_buffer.set_time_lag(time_lags, env_ids)\n        self.velocities_delay_buffer.set_time_lag(time_lags, env_ids)\n        self.efforts_delay_buffer.set_time_lag(time_lags, env_ids)\n        # reset buffers\n        self.positions_delay_buffer.reset(env_ids)\n        self.velocities_delay_buffer.reset(env_ids)\n        self.efforts_delay_buffer.reset(env_ids)\n\n    def compute(\n        self, control_action: ArticulationActions, joint_pos: torch.Tensor, joint_vel: torch.Tensor\n    ) -> ArticulationActions:\n        # apply delay based on the delay the model for all the setpoints\n        control_action.joint_positions = self.positions_delay_buffer.compute(control_action.joint_positions)\n        control_action.joint_velocities = self.velocities_delay_buffer.compute(control_action.joint_velocities)\n        control_action.joint_efforts = self.efforts_delay_buffer.compute(control_action.joint_efforts)\n        # compte actuator model\n        return super().compute(control_action, joint_pos, joint_vel)\n\n\nclass RemotizedPDActuator(DelayedPDActuator):\n    \"\"\"Ideal PD actuator with angle-dependent torque limits.\n\n    This class extends the :class:`DelayedPDActuator` class by adding angle-dependent torque limits to the actuator.\n    The torque limits are applied by querying a lookup table describing the relationship between the joint angle\n    and the maximum output torque. remove effort and velocity box constraints from the base class\n        cfg.effort_limit = torch.inf\n        cfg.velocity_limit = torch.inf\n        # call the base method and set default effort_limit and velocity_limit to inf\n        super().__init__(\n            cfg,\n            joint_names,\n            joint_ids,\n            num_envs,\n            device,\n            stiffness,\n            damping,\n            armature,\n            friction,\n            dynamic_friction,\n            viscous_friction,\n            effort_limit,\n            velocity_limit,\n        )\n        self._joint_parameter_lookup = torch.tensor(cfg.joint_parameter_lookup, device=device)\n        # define remotized joint torque limit\n        self._torque_limit = LinearInterpolation(self.angle_samples, self.max_torque_samples, device=device)\n\n    \"\"\"\n    Properties.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    @property\n    def angle_samples(self) -> torch.Tensor:\n        return self._joint_parameter_lookup[:, 0]\n\n    @property\n    def transmission_ratio_samples(self) -> torch.Tensor:\n        return self._joint_parameter_lookup[:, 1]\n\n    @property\n    def max_torque_samples(self) -> torch.Tensor:\n        return self._joint_parameter_lookup[:, 2]\n\n    \"\"\"\n    Operations.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def compute(\n        self, control_action: ArticulationActions, joint_pos: torch.Tensor, joint_vel: torch.Tensor\n    ) -> ArticulationActions:\n        #  def __init__(self, cfg, *args, **kwargs):\r\n        super().__init__(cfg, *args, **kwargs)\r\n        # ActuatorBase keeps the environment count and device private.\r\n        self.episode_scale = torch.ones(self._num_envs, 1, device=self._device)\r\n        self.step_scale = torch.ones(self._num_envs, 1, device=self._device)\r\n\r\n    def _ids(self, env_ids):\r\n        # The event manager calls step/reset terms with env_ids=None for \"all environments\";\r\n        # the original code assumed a tensor and would have raised on the very first call\r\n        # (which never happened because \"step\" mode is not applied by stock Isaac Lab).\r\n        if env_ids is None:\r\n            return torch.arange(self._num_envs, device=self._device)\r\n        if isinstance(env_ids, slice):\r\n            return torch.arange(self._num_envs, device=self._device)[env_ids]\r\n        return env_ids\r\n\r\n    def resample_episode_scale(self, env_ids, low: float, high: float) -> None:\r\n        ids = self._ids(env_ids)\r\n        n = int(ids.numel())\r\n        self.episode_scale[ids] = torch.empty(n, 1, device=self._device).uniform_(low, high)\r\n\r\n    def resample_step_scale(self, env_ids, low: float, high: float) -> None:\r\n        ids = self._ids(env_ids)\r\n        n = int(ids.numel())\r\n        self.step_scale[ids] = torch.empty(n, 1, device=self._device).uniform_(low, high)\r\n\r\n    def _clip_effort(self, effort: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\r\n        scaled = super()._clip_effort(effort) * self.episode_scale *                      device=self.buf.device)\r\n        self.age[env_ids] = 0\r\n\r\n    def push(self, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\r\n        self.buf = torch.roll(self.buf, 1, dims=0)\r\n It is implemented as:\\n\\n    .. math::\\n\\n        \\\\tau_{j, max} & = \\\\gamma \\\\times \\\\tau_{motor, max} \\\\\\\\\\n        \\\\tau_{j, applied} & = clip(\\\\tau_{computed}, -\\\\tau_{j, max}, \\\\tau_{j, max})\\n\\n    where the clipping function is defined as :math:`clip(x, x_{min}, x_{max}) = min(max(x, x_{min}), x_{max})`.\\n    The parameters :math:`\\\\gamma` is the gear ratio of the gear box connecting the motor and the actuated joint ends,\\n    and :math:`\\\\tau_{motor, max}` is the maximum motor effort possible. These parameters are read from\\n    the configuration instance passed to the class.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    cfg: IdealPDActuatorCfg\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"The configuration for the actuator model.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Operations.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    def reset(self, env_ids: Sequence[int]):\\n        pass\\n\\n    def compute(\\n        self, control_action: ArticulationActions, joint_pos: torch.Tensor, joint_vel: torch.Tensor\\n    ) -> ArticulationActions:\\n        # compute errors\\n        error_pos = control_action.joint_positions - joint_pos\\n        error_vel = control_action.joint_velocities - joint_vel\\n        # calculate the desired joint torques\\n        self.computed_effort = self.stiffness * error_pos + self.damping * error_vel + control_action.joint_efforts\\n        # clip the torques based on the motor limits\\n        self.applied_effort = self._clip_effort(self.computed_effort)\\n        # set the computed actions back into the control action\\n        control_action.joint_efforts = self.applied_effort\\n        control_action.joint_positions = None\\n        control_action.joint_velocities = None\\n        return control_action\\n\\n\\nclass DCMotor(IdealPDActuator):\\n    r\\\"\\\"\\\"Direct control (DC) motor actuator model with velocity-based saturation model.\\n\\n    It uses the same model as the :class:`IdealPDActuator` for computing the torques from input commands.\\n    However, it implements a saturation model defined by a linear four quadrant DC motor torque-speed curve.\\n\\n    A DC motor is a type of electric motor that is powered by direct current electricity. In most cases,\\n    the motor is connected to a constant source of voltage supply, and the current is controlled by a rheostat.\\n    Depending on various design factors such as windings and materials, the motor can draw a limited maximum power\\n    from the electronic source, which limits the produced motor torque and speed.\\n\\n    A DC motor characteristics are defined by the following parameters:\\n\\n    * No-load speed (:math:`\\\\dot{q}_{motor, max}`) : The maximum-rated speed of the motor at\\n      zero torque (:attr:`velocity_limit`).\\n    * Stall torque (:math:`\\\\tau_{motor, stall}`): The maximum-rated torque produced at\\n      zero speed (:attr:`saturation_effort`).\\n    * Continuous torque (:math:`\\\\tau_{motor, con}`): The maximum torque that can be outputted for a short period.\\n      This is often enforced on the current drives for a DC motor to limit overheating, prevent mechanical damage,\\n      or enforced by electrical limitations (:attr:`effort_limit`).\\n    * Corner velocity (:math:`V_{c}`): The velocity where the torque-speed curve intersects with continuous torque.\\n\\n    Based on these parameters, the instantaneous minimum and maximum torques for velocities between corner velocities\\n    (where torque-speed curve intersects with continuous torque) are defined as follows:\\n\\n    .. math::\\n\\n        \\\\tau_{j, max}(\\\\dot{q}) & = clip \\\\left (\\\\tau_{j, stall} \\\\times \\\\left(1 -\\n            \\\\frac{\\\\dot{q}}{\\\\dot{q}_{j, max}}\\\\right), -\\u221e, \\\\tau_{j, con} \\\\right) \\\\\\\\\\n        \\\\tau_{j, min}(\\\\dot{q}) & = clip \\\\left (\\\\tau_{j, stall} \\\\times \\\\left( -1 -\\n            \\\\frac{\\\\dot{q}}{\\\\dot{q}_{j, max}}\\\\right), - \\\\tau_{j, con}, \\u221e \\\\right)\\n\\n    where :math:`\\\\gamma` is the gear ratio of the gear box connecting the motor and the actuated joint ends,\\n    :math:`\\\\dot{q}_{j, max} = \\\\gamma^{-1} \\\\times  \\\\dot{q}_{motor, max}`, :math:`\\\\tau_{j, con} =\\n    \\\\gamma \\\\times \\\\tau_{motor, con}` and :math:`\\\\tau_{j, stall} = \\\\gamma \\\\times \\\\tau_{motor, stall}`\\n    are the maximum joint velocity, continuous joint torque and stall torque, respectively. These parameters\\n    are read from the configuration instance passed to the class.\\n\\n    Using these values, the computed torques are clipped to the minimum and maximum values based on the\\n    instantaneous joint velocity:\\n\\n    .. math::\\n\\n        \\\\tau_{j, applied} = clip(\\\\tau_{computed}, \\\\tau_{j, min}(\\\\dot{q}), \\\\tau_{j, max}(\\\\dot{q}))\\n\\n    If the velocity of the joint is outside corner velocities (this would be due to external forces) the\\n    applied output torque will be driven to the Continuous Torque (`effort_limit`).\\n\\n    The figure below demonstrates the clipping action for example (velocity, torque) pairs.\\n\\n    .. figure:: ../../_static/actuator-group/dc_motor_clipping.jpg\\n        :align: center\\n        :figwidth: 100%\\n        :alt: The effort clipping as a function of joint velocity for a linear DC Motor.\\n\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    cfg: DCMotorCfg\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"The configuration for the actuator model.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    def __init__(self, cfg: DCMotorCfg, *args, **kwargs):\\n        super().__init__(cfg, *args, **kwargs)\\n        # find the velocity on the torque-speed curve that intersects effort_limit in the second and fourth quadrant\\n        self._vel_at_effort_lim = self.velocity_limit * (1 + self.effort_limit / self._saturation_effort)\\n        # prepare joint vel buffer for max effort computation\\n        self._joint_vel = torch.zeros_like(self.computed_effort)\\n        # create buffer for zeros effort\\n        self._zeros_effort = torch.zeros_like(self.computed_effort)\\n        # save current joint vel\\n        self._joint_vel[:] = torch.clip(self._joint_vel, min=-self._vel_at_effort_lim, max=self._vel_at_effort_lim)\\n        # compute torque limits\\n        torque_speed_top = self._saturation_effort * (1.0 - self._joint_vel / self.velocity_limit)\\n        torque_speed_bottom = self._saturation_effort * (-1.0 - self._joint_vel / self.velocity_limit)\\n        # reset buffers\\n        self.positions_delay_buffer.reset(env_ids)\\n        self.velocities_delay_buffer.reset(env_ids)\\n        self.efforts_delay_buffer.reset(env_ids)\\n\\n    def compute(\\n        self, control_action: ArticulationActions, joint_pos: torch.Tensor, joint_vel: torch.Tensor\\n    ) -> ArticulationActions:\\n        #       self.lag = torch.zeros(num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=device)\\r\\n        self.age = torch.zeros(num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=device)\\r\\n        self.resample(torch.arange(num_envs, device=device))\\r\\n\\r\\n    def resample(self, env_ids) -> None:\\r\\n        n = env_ids.numel()\\r\\n        self.lag[env_ids] = torch.randint(self.min_lag, self.max_lag + 1, (n,),\\r\\n                                         device=self.buf.device)\\r\\n        self.age[env_ids] = 0\\r\\n\\r\\n    def push(self, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\\r\\n        self.buf = torch.roll(self.buf, 1, dims=0)\\r\\n        self.buf[0] = value\\r\\n        self.age += 1\\r\\n        due = self.age >= self.period\\r\\n        if due.any():\\r\\n            ids = due.nonzero(as_tuple=False).flatten()\\r\\n            keep = torch.rand(ids.numel(), device=self.buf.device) < self.hold_prob\\r\\n            change = ids[~keep]\\r\\n            if change.numel():\\r\\n                self.resample(change)\\r\\n            self.age[ids] = 0\\r\\n        idx = self.lag.clamp(max=self.buf.shape[0] - 1)\\r\\n        return self.buf[idx,    def _init_delay(self, min_lag: int, max_lag: int, hold_prob: float,\\r\\n                    period: int) -> None:\\r\\n        self._min_lag, self._max_lag = int(min_lag), max(int(max_lag),    device=self.device)\\r\\n        self._resample_lag(torch.arange(self.num_envs, device=self.device))\\r\\n\\r\\n    def _resample_lag(self, env_ids) -> None:\\r\\n        n = env_ids.numel()\\r\\n        self._lag[env_ids] = torch.randint(self._min_lag, self._max_lag + 1, (n,),\\r\\n                                           device=self.device)\\r\\n        self._age[env_ids] = 0\\r\\n\\r\\n self._resample_lag(env_ids)\\r\\n        # P0-3 (audit 2026-09-11): drop the previous episode's actions from the delay\\r\\n        # line, otherwise the first steps of a new episode replay        self._age[ids] = 0\\r\\n        idx = self._lag.clamp(max=self._hist.shape[0] - 1)\\r\\n        delayed_actions = self._hist[idx, torch.arange(self.num_envs, device=self.device)]\\r\\n
